  • Du gir kunden den beste opplevelsen

  • Du medvirker positivt til et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Du har grunnleggende datakunnskaper


Hva kan du forvente av oss?

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver

  • Et ungt, aktivt og morsomt miljø

  • Strukturerte arbeidsforhold

  • Muligheter til å lære mye nytt om mennesker og bil

  • Utviklingsmuligheter innen bransjen

 

Som ansatt i Hertz er du med på laget til Norges største mobilitetsselskap der du er en del av en engasjert gjeng som er opptatt av å levere kvalitet til hver eneste kunde. 

Alle søknader med CV skal registreres i vårt rekrutteringssystem, følg link.
Søknader som sendes direkte i mail vil ikke bli behandlet, kun slettes.
Kandidater vurderes fortløpende.

 

Vi følger overenskomsten for bilutleie.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hertz – et ledende bildelingsselskap. Hertz er representert mer enn 150 land på samtlige kontinenter med over 11 000 lokasjoner. Hertz er Norges største bildelingsselskap og en betydelig aktør i den raskt voksende delingsøkonomien. De seneste ti årene har vi hatt en årlig vekst på ca. 20 prosent, og har nå over 500 utleiepunkter, inkludert samtlige flyplasser. Bilflåten i Norge består av flere enn 10 000 nye biler fra verdens ledende produsenter, som leies ut via et landsdekkende nettverk. Hertz vil være førstevalget innen bilutleie og en markant aktør i den nye delingsøkonomien med heldigitale delings- og mobilitetsløsninger. Vi har store ambisjoner for fremtiden og ser et betydelig vekstpotensial i at stadig flere vil leie og dele biler fremfor å eie selv. Samtlige lokasjoner i Hertz Norge er miljø- og kvalitetssertifisert gjennom standardene ISO 14001, 9001 og 45001 (HMS).

Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  

About this opportunity:







BNEW RCE Lab Operations provides infrastructure services for R&D IT and test environments. As an ICT Architect in the Systems Security and Business Strategy unit, you ensure we have the right input to make informed technical decisions, drive innovation, and stay aligned with partner organizations using and managing R&D IT and test environments.



Our unit is responsible for making sure BNEW RCE Lab Ops services comply with mandatory security and architecture requirements, while also driving technology changes so Ericsson’s R&D community has a best-in-class test and development environment.



In this enterprise architect role, you will own and drive technical inquiries and collaborate with stakeholders to improve the user environment. You will lead both high-level and detailed architectural studies within Lab Operations and across R&D IT, with a strong holistic mindset and global architectural responsibility for the services we provide.







What you will do:



- Develop a deep understanding of the current architecture, our services, and how they fit into the R&D IT landscape.- Act as a technical leader, driving DevSecOps practices and initiating MLOps capabilities.- Design, develop, and manage high-performance GPU clusters optimized for AI workloads.- Contribute to physical lab infrastructure and hardware asset management, including networking, storage, management infrastructure, and security services.- Use your broad IT knowledge and specialized expertise to solve complex problems and improve our service offering.- Collaborate with the manager, team lead, peer architects, and security analysts within the unit.- Work with the Architecture function in the RCE Lab Ops DevSecOps program to align solutions with architectural and security requirements.- Engage with peer architects from other R&D IT organizations in BNEW and BCSS to ensure architectural coherence and share best practices.- Partner with Service Domain Managers to shape and evolve services in the BNEW RCE Lab Ops portfolio.- Participate in Solution and Service Architect communities within BNEW RCE Lab Ops to contribute to common standards and guidelines.







The skills you bring:



- Architectural experience within the IT area, including Enterprise Architecture- Broad understanding of relevant technologies, i.e., storage solutions, IT security, IP networking, monitoring and their use in large enterprise environments- Expertise in one area is beneficial- Hands-on experience with today's IT systems, giving your technological expertise a foundation in today's reality- A desire for technological excellence, knowledge and understanding, including (but not necessarily limited to):  - The AI/Machine learning lifecycle and operationalization  - Automation in IT  - Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)  - Datacenter and WAN networking  - Storage, both today's and software-defined storage systems  - Monitoring systems  - Enabling services such as time services, DNS, DHCP, etc.- A collaborative spirit since our team only succeeds when working with others to reach our goals- A wide contact network within Ericsson or a demonstrable ability to build such a network- Good organizational skills for handling a constantly evolving work environment- Skills to independently drive studies across virtual teams within or across R&D IT organizations- Knowledge in Information and IT Security processes (ISMS/ISO27k) and technology are a benefit

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help shape a business-critical platform used for range planning in a large retail environment. The solution recommends article lists and supports teams with data-driven decisions across planning and establishment processes, making it a central part of how the business works with its offer.

In this role, you will work across frontend, backend and data integrations while contributing to an ongoing cloud transition from GCP and Kubernetes-based hosting to Azure-based solutions. You will get real end-to-end influence in a modern platform where scalable architecture, clean engineering and practical business impact go hand in hand.

Job Description

    You will develop and maintain a Vue 3 single-page application using Vuetify and SCSS.
    You will build, improve and scale Python FastAPI services together with related data pipelines.
    You will integrate the platform with BigQuery, Databricks and the RST 2.0 Data API.
    You will implement secure authentication flows using Auth0 and network-based identity.
    You will support the cloud transition by working with solutions across GCP, Kubernetes and Azure.
    You will automate dbt pipelines used to update BigQuery tables and contribute to data-platform related workflows.
    You will enable Excel export functionality using XlsxWriter.

Requirements

    5+ years of full-stack development experience
    Strong expertise in Vue.js, Python, FastAPI, and cloud-native architecture
    Experience with Auth0 and Kubernetes
    Experience working with both GCP and Azure as cloud providers
    Familiarity with CI/CD, environment-based configuration, and secure API design
    You write clean, scalable code and enjoy working closely with others in collaborative development

Nice to have

    SQL and GraphQL
    dbt
    BigQuery
    Delta Sharing, Databricks, or similar analytics/data-platform integrations
    Experience generating Excel exports using XlsxWriter

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: RESPONSABLE DE SITE ITINERANT (H/F)
jobs.description:
Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F)

Un poste de terrain, au cœur de nos résidences
Vous aimez les environnements variés, les nouveaux défis et les missions qui ont du sens ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de plusieurs établissements plutôt que d'un seul ?
Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F) et devenez un véritable référent opérationnel au sein de notre réseau de 16 résidences Appart'Hôtels implantées dans la partie Est de France.

Qui sommes-nous ?
KOSY Appart'Hôtels, exploité par Habitat Gestion, c'est :
- Un réseau de 16 résidences,
- Présents dans 9 villes,
- Exploitant près de 1 400 logements en France,
- Avec plus de 25 ans d'expertise.
Implantés à Forbach, Saint-Avold, Reims, Nancy, Troyes, Mâcon, Grenoble, Aix-Les-Bains et Avignon.
Nous accueillons étudiants, professionnels et voyageurs en leur proposant des solutions d'hébergement tout confort, de la nuitée au séjour longue durée. Nos appartements, du studio au T2, sont entièrement meublés et équipés, avec Wi-Fi et de nombreux services à la carte.
Vous recherchez un poste où autonomie, diversité des missions et proximité avec la direction sont une réalité ? Rejoignez Kosy et participez au développement de notre réseau de résidences.
Pour en savoir plus : www.kosy-apparthotels.com

Votre mission :
Rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel, votre mission s'articule autour de deux axes principaux :
- Renforcer les équipes lors des pics d'activité, des rentrées universitaires, des périodes touristiques ou tout autre besoin opérationnel.
- Remplacer les responsables de résidence pendant leurs absences (congés, formations, maladie, etc.) afin de garantir le bon fonctionnement de chaque établissement.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à :
- (Co)-piloter l'exploitation quotidienne d'une résidence ;
- Garantir un accueil client de qualité et veiller à la satisfaction de nos résidents et clients ;
- Accompagner, coordonner et soutenir les équipes présentes sur site (interne ou externe) ;
- Suivre l'activité commerciale et respecter les objectifs de taux d'occupation ;
- Assurer le suivi administratif et opérationnel de l'établissement ;
- Veiller au respect des procédures, des standards qualité et des règles de sécurité ;
- Accompagner les équipes lors des périodes de forte activité et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de leurs process.

Profil souhaité :
Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement d'hébergement (résidence de services, résidence étudiante, appart'hôtel).
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
- votre autonomie ;
- votre capacité d'adaptation ;
- votre sens de l'organisation ;
- votre réactivité ;
Vous appréciez les environnements variés, savez rapidement prendre vos marques dans un nouvel établissement et aimez relever de nouveaux défis.
Ce poste implique des déplacements de 2 à 3 semaines par trimestre, principalement sur nos résidences de Reims, Mâcon, Saint-Avold et Grenoble, afin d'assurer les remplacements ou de renforcer les équipes selon les besoins de l'exploitation.
Vous êtes directement rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel.
En dehors des périodes de remplacement, le poste est rattaché au siège, à Nancy.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
- Une grande autonomie dans vos missions.
- Une forte diversité d'environnements et de rencontres.
- Une proximité immédiate avec la direction générale.
- L'opportunité de développer vos compétences sur plusieurs typologies d'établissements.
- Une entreprise à taille humaine, attachée à la proximité, à la qualité de service et à l'accompagnement de ses équipes.

Informations complémentaires
- CDI - 39h
- Statut : Agent de Maîtrise
- Convention collective de l'immobilier (IDCC 1527)
- Mutuelle d'entreprise
- Prise en charge des déplacements et hébergement par Kosy lors des missions.
- Rémunération annuelle brute : 33 000 € sur 13 mois

jobs.title: Project & Business Coordinator
jobs.employer: AVINCIS AVIATION NORWAY AS BASE TROMSØ
jobs.description:
Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics



The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 
  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 
  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 
  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 
  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 
  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 
  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 
  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 
  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 
  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 
  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 
  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 
Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 
  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 
  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 
  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 
  • An understanding of risk management and governance 
  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 
  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 
  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis?

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics. 

KontaktinformasjonStina Johansson, HR Business Partner, Stina.Johansson@avincis.com
Kristine Lysö Mikkelsen, HR Business Partner, kristinelyso.mikkelsen@avincis.com

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.



Job Summary

The OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Components team at Processing Equipment AB is recruiting a Technical Product Manager to own and develop the product portfolio within Electrical and Automation. The location for this position is Lund, Sweden.



What you will do

The team is responsible for owning and developing the global product portfolios of OEM components. The components are identified and purchased, based on internal needs and external insights and capabilities, from selected suppliers and intended to support all three businesses: Packaging, Processing and Services. As example the team owns portfolios of pumps, valves, electrical components, pneumatics, motors, drives etc.



The aim for the team is to drive standardization of OEM components across Tetra Pak and to secure that the component portfolio supports the business success for Tetra Pak on short and long term. Through close and continuous stakeholder collaboration, we improve the OEM portfolios to ensure competitiveness, and to support business strategies whilst complying to Tetra Pak standards and legal requirements.



You will be a part of a technically skilled team with the focus on creating, managing, supporting, deploying and developing a competitive global standard portfolio of OEM components. You will work closely with our suppliers as well as with internal stakeholders across Tetra Pak, such as Business Streams, the Project organization, Services, Development & Technology (D&T) and Supplier Management.



As a Technical Product Manager you will:

    Select the components for the Electrical & Automation portfolio, to drive standardization and support business strategies across Tetra Pak
    Drive product deployment and standardization
    Manage your portfolio of components throughout its lifecycle
    Support internal stakeholders with technical support
    Lead the technical dialogue with suppliers on e.g. specifications
    Create and perform internal product trainings
    Own and be responsible for the portfolio to be well structured in terms of e.g. product information, documentation and compliance
    Ensure components are compliant with legal demands and Tetra Pak requirements
    Proactively make sure that information related to the components is easily available and that technical information is communicated to relevant stakeholders in a structured way
    Continuously develop and improve your portfolio to support stakeholders’ long-term business strategies
    Actively build and engage with your portfolio stakeholders
    Set and execute on targets for the portfolio, based on overarching team goals
    Create and implement your portfolio strategy in close collaboration with Supplier management and other key stakeholders
    Be continuously aware of short- and long-term internal needs, as well as external trends and shifts, relevant to your portfolio
    Together with Supplier Management drive actions with suppliers to improve quality where needed
    Contribute to continuous improvements in and around your and the team’s work to improve productivity and quality

We believe you have



    University degree or equivalent in engineering or similar work experience
    At least 5 years of relevant work experience in a similar role
    Technical knowledge and personal experience in Electrical and Automation
    Strategy driven, yet technically proficient and considerate about the details
    Experience in technical product and/or portfolio management
    Excellent stakeholder management and networking skills
    Good verbal and written communication skills
    Fluent English language knowledge
    Experience in data & analytics for Product management is preferred

We Offer You

    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements



Apply Now

If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.

This job posting expires on 2026-08-25.

If you have any questions about your application, please contact Rita Necsei at +36 23 88 5380

To know more about the position contact Linda Lindenberg at +46 46 36 3781



For trade union information, contact Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 and Sveriges Ingenjörer Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533

A background check may be performed on the final candidate as part of the recruitment process.



Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Platform Specialist, Konecranes
jobs.description:
_Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs. Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination._

**Would you be our new Embedded Linux Platform Specialist?**

As an Embedded Linux Platform Specialist, you will help expand an existing Linux platform and related CI/CD practices across Konecranes' Port Solutions business. The foundation is already in place, and your role is to learn the existing solution, develop it further and help other products and engineering teams adopt the same platform and practices.

This is a newly created, hands-on technical role where you will focus on Linux operating system development and work closely with a software development and testing team in Finland while your manager is located in the Netherlands. You will work with an ISAR-based Linux platform, contributing to operating system updates, packaging and platform maintenance, while also developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. As you become familiar with the existing solution, you will take increasing ownership of adapting and expanding it to meet the needs of other teams across Konecranes Port Solutions organization.

You will collaborate with engineering teams in Finland and across the Europe, mainly Germany and Italy, which means that part of your role is also about sharing technical knowledge, understanding different teams' needs and helping them make effective use of the platform. Occasional travel within Europe is expected, typically a few times per year.

This is a full-time and permanent position. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. This role follows a flexible hybrid working model. You can work remotely based on your tasks and preferences, while we expect you to join your colleagues at the office when the work or team collaboration requires it. Especially during onboarding, regular presence in Hyvinkää is important so that you can work closely with the team members and become familiar with the platform and working environment.

**What are we looking for?**

What matters most in this role is strong hands-on Linux expertise combined with some previous working experience in industrial IT, industrial software development or a comparable OT environment. You have a relevant educational background but your practical expertise and ability to understand technical environments matter more than a specific educational background.

You understand Linux beyond application development and are familiar with areas such as operating system updates, packaging and maintaining Linux based platforms. Experience with Yocto or ISAR is valuable. You have a good understanding of the principles how CI/CD pipelines are built, maintained and integrated into software development. Experience with technologies such as Jenkins, Git, Groovy, Python and Grafana, as well as knowledge of networking and OT environments, is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are eager to learn and develop your expertise in Konecranes products and solutions. You are proactive and take ownership of your responsibilities independently. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are important, as you will collaborate with both internal and external stakeholders, support other teams when needed and work together to find the best technical solutions across different teams and cultures. Fluent spoken and written English skills are essential, while other language skills, such as Finnish, German or Italian, are considered an advantage.

**Why Konecranes?**

This newly created role gives you the opportunity to shape your responsibilities while helping scale proven Linux platforms and software development practices across Port Solutions. Your work has a tangible impact, supporting large container handling equipment and automated terminal solutions operating around the world.

Konecranes is a stable and international company where work is approached with a long-term mindset and a focus on the future. You will become part of a close-knit team of professionals where collaboration, open communication and shared goals are an integral part of everyday work.

From day one, you will receive a comprehensive onboarding and the support you need to succeed in your role. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to broaden your expertise through diverse international projects and continue growing as a professional.

Konecranes is committed to continuous learning, internal career opportunities and long-term professional development. The company offers excellent opportunities to shape your own career path and progress into a variety of specialist or other roles with greater responsibility within the organization.

**Have we got your interest?**

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 2.9.2026. We process the applications and start the interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Hannamari Ukkonen, Recruitment Consultant via email at**hannamari.ukkonen@biisoni.fi**

Please note that we only process applications submitted through our recruitment system. We are unable to accept applications sent by email.

jobs.title: Project & Business Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project & Business Coordinator

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark.

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action.

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation.

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics
    Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting
    Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up
    Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives
    Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions
    Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments
    Supporting commercial activities and tender processes
    Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material
    Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting
    Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation
    Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives
    Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential.

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders.

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role.

We would also like you to have:

    Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills
    An understanding of financial analysis and business cases
    Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities
    Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes
    An understanding of risk management and governance
    Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language
    Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders

Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful?

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward.

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done.

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures.

Why join Avincis?

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions.

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics.

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you.

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a team committed to securing patient data in the cutting-edge world of IT security at Sectra!

We are looking for junior Security Operations Engineers with a strong foundation in computer science and a genuine interest in cloud security and data protection. You’ll be part of a global security team working on real-world challenges in a modern, cloud-based environment within Enterprise Imaging.

In this role, you’ll work closely with experienced security engineers and architects to design, operate, and improve security controls that protect critical healthcare data worldwide. You’ll gain hands-on experience with current security technologies, cloud platforms, and large-scale systems—while contributing to a mission that truly matters.

This role is a great fit if you enjoy solving complex technical problems, learning fast, and working in an environment where security is taken seriously and continuously evolving. At Sectra, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills, take responsibility early, and make a measurable impact on how patient data is protected.

If you want to build a career in IT security and work on meaningful, technically challenging systems, we’d love to hear from you!

Your responsibilities will include:

    Administer and operate key security features within the Sectra solution, including vulnerability management, alert handling, log management, and more.
    Work with our Security Operations Center to optimize security responses and ensure any triggered alerts are handled swiftly.
    Work with colleagues and customers around the globe to help them understand current security threats and provide actionable solutions.
    Implement and improve security controls in crucial areas such as Identity and Access Management, Data Protection, and more.
    Analyze and monitor security systems to ensure top-tier protection, while developing insightful security reports.
    Contribute to developing and maintaining security automation that streamlines processes and strengthens defenses.
    Help deploy and support security solutions, both proprietary and third-party, to keep our systems ahead of evolving threats.

Skills & Requirements

At Sectra, we hire for attitude and ability – train for skill. This means who you are and what you can do is more important than your previous experiences. There are a few core abilities that are central for any role. We always look for your willingness and ability to learn and take on new tasks fast, utilize previous experiences and quickly grasp new information. We also want you to have a strong analytical mindset in which we consider it to be important that you can understand and break down and solve problems. We are also looking for good communicators who can interact with colleagues, partners and customers in an effective, clear and constructive way.

In addition to these abilities, we also want you to:

    Have a master’s degree within engineering, IT or similar field - with a strong academic record
    Be fluent in English and Swedish
    Have a passion for data security and a curiosity about emerging security areas and cloud technologies
    Appreciate working in a collaborative environment and contribute to a global team
    Have a desire to learn and grow in the IT security field and develop your skills through hands-on experience.

We consider it a great asset if you:

    Have previous experience within system administration or networking
    Have previous experience within IT security

Other information:

We recruit on an ongoing basis. This means we encourage you to apply or contact us as soon as possible!

A mandatory background security screening will be performed as part of the recruitment process at Sectra. Please reach out to the responsible hiring team if you have any questions regarding this. Learn more about our recruitment process here.

jobs.title: Operations Quality Engineer to Västerås 🔍
jobs.description:
About the Role

Wrknest is looking for an Operations Quality Engineer on behalf of a client. In this role, you will support the Operations Quality Manager with quality expertise to ensure and continuously improve quality throughout the production processes.

You will work both operationally and strategically, monitoring quality performance, analysing deviations and identifying opportunities for improvement. The role involves close collaboration with Production, Supplier Quality, R&D and Production Engineering. You will also initiate and drive Lean Six Sigma activities aimed at reducing scrap, rework and other quality-related issues.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working close to production, where several challenges may need attention at the same time. You will have the opportunity to work throughout the improvement process, from data analysis and root cause investigation to implementation and follow-up of corrective actions.

Your Future Responsibilities

As an Operations Quality Engineer, you will have a broad role within quality assurance and continuous improvement. You will analyse quality performance, drive improvement activities together with relevant stakeholders and ensure that identified issues are translated into effective actions.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Monitoring, analysing and reporting quality parameters from production

    

Initiating and driving Lean Six Sigma activities and improvement projects

    

Identifying opportunities for improvement related to areas such as scrap and rework

    

Performing root cause analyses and reporting identified issues to R&D and Production Engineering

    

Managing and following up deviations in SAP

    

Supporting Production, Supplier Quality, R&D and other relevant functions in quality-related matters

    

Initiating and driving production and delivery stops when required from a quality perspective

    

Supporting Production Engineering in developing PFMEA and Control Plans

    

Actively participating in the Andon process

    

Performing internal audits

    

Leading Continuous Improvement activities

    

Supporting managers with quality-related training and education of personnel

    

Supporting Customer Product Support

    

Participating in production-related projects

We Are Looking for Someone Who

To succeed in this role, you have a solid understanding of quality management in a production environment and practical experience with established quality tools and improvement methodologies.

Requirements:

    

Strong knowledge and practical experience in quality management tools and methodologies

    

Practical experience with Lean Six Sigma

    

Knowledge of APQP

    

Experience working with Control Plans

    

Experience working with PFMEA

You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are comfortable handling several issues in parallel while maintaining focus on long-term improvements. Since the role involves collaboration across different functions as well as contact with suppliers and end customers, you communicate clearly and can adapt your approach to different stakeholders. You demonstrate integrity in your work and are comfortable driving quality-related topics forward when different perspectives and priorities need to be balanced.

Additional Information

Start date: As agreed

Location: Västerås

Employment scope: Full-time

Employment type: Consultant via wrknest for at least 6 months

About the Client

The client operates within a production environment where quality, continuous improvement and structured processes are central to their operations. They work cross-functionally across areas such as Production, Quality, R&D and Production Engineering to maintain stable processes and consistently high product quality.

As an Operations Quality Engineer, you will have a central role in this work, with the opportunity to influence both day-to-day production quality and long-term improvement initiatives.

About Wrknest

At Wrknest, we don’t do things like everyone else. We believe in constantly exploring new opportunities and thinking differently. When Wrknest was founded, the ambition was to challenge traditional ways of recruiting.

We live in a time of rapid digital development. Knowledge needs to be continuously renewed to stay relevant, which means being able to adapt quickly. That is why Wrknest looks beyond a candidate’s CV in the recruitment process. Instead, the focus is on overall potential, combined with individually tailored upskilling. This enables Wrknest to quickly match the skills that are needed right now. Read more at www.wrknest.se.

jobs.title: Kiinteistönvälittäjä / myyntineuvottelija
jobs.description:
Meillä töitä riittää ja toimeksiantoja on heti hoidettavaksi. Olemme tehneet keskimäärin n. 60 kauppaa vuodessa, ja tavoitteenamme on kasvattaa toimintaa yhdessä uuden tekijän kanssa kohti sataa kauppaa vuodessa.

Etsimme nyt omatoimista, tarkkaa ja myyntihenkistä tekijää, joka ottaa vastuun omasta tekemisestään.

Toimipaikkamme sijaitsee Laihialla, mutta kohteemme sijaitsevat laajasti Laihian, Vaasan, Vähänkyrön, Isonkyrön ja Ylistaron alueilla. Työ on liikkuvaa ja työpäivät vievät sinne, missä asiakkaamme ja kohteemme ovat.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

**Sujuvan aloituksen:**

Sinun ei tarvitse aloittaa tyhjästä. Saat heti työn alle yrityksen valmiita toimeksiantoja, joten pääset kiinni tekemiseen alusta alkaen.

**Täyden tuen työhösi:**

Saat käyttöösi viimeisimmät järjestelmät ja tuen sekä apua aina tarvittaessa. Et jää yksin haastavissakaan tilanteissa. Vastaat kuitenkin omista toimeksiannoistasi itsenäisesti alusta loppuun ja huolehdit siitä, että asiat tulevat tehdyiksi ajallaan ja huolellisesti.

**Turvallisen ja motivoivan palkkamallin:**

Tarjoamme aidon kiinteän pohjapalkan, jonka päälle reilut provisiot.

**Kiinteä pohjapalkka:**

1 000 euroa / kk.

**Myyntiprovisiot pohjapalkan päälle:**

30 % itse hankkimiesi kohteiden välityspalkkiosta ja 15 % yrityksen sinulle antamien kohteiden välityspalkkioista (laskettuna arvonlisäverottomasta välityspalkkiosta).

**Vuokraprovisiot pohjapalkan päälle:**

50 % itse hankkimiesi toimeksiantojen vuokravälityspalkkioista ja 30 % yrityksen sinulle antamien kohteiden vuokravälityspalkkioista (laskettuna arvonlisäverottomasta välityspalkkiosta).

T**yöajot**:

Oman auton käytöstä työajoihin maksetaan kilometrikorvaukset 25snt/km.

**Vapautta ja joustavuutta:**

Tarjoamme itsenäisen työnkuvan, joustavuutta työn tekemiseen ja matalan hierarkian ilman suuren ketjun kankeita rakenteita. Saat vastuuta, mutta samalla myös vapautta hoitaa työsi tehokkaasti omalla tavallasi.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

**Omatoimisuutta ja tarkkuutta:**

Nämä ovat tehtävässä ehdottomia edellytyksiä. Etsimme henkilöä, joka tarttuu asioihin itsenäisesti, pitää langat käsissään ja vie aloittamansa asiat loppuun asti. Kiinteistönvälityksessä yksityiskohdilla on merkitystä, joten järjestelmällisyys, huolellisuus ja vastuunotto ovat tehtävässä välttämättömiä. Sovituista asioista pidetään kiinni.

**Oikeaa asennetta ja nälkää:**

Kokemus välitysalalta on plussaa, mutta asenne, myyntihenkisyys ja halu oppia ratkaisevat. Voit olla kokenut välittäjä tai esimerkiksi muun myyntialan ammattilainen, joka haluaa rakentaa uransa kiinteistönvälityksessä.

**Valmiutta ilta- ja viikonlopputyöhön:**

Kiinteistönvälitystyössä asiakastapaamiset ja esittelyt sijoittuvat usein myös iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin. Tehtävä edellyttää valmiutta työskennellä joustavasti myös normaalien toimistoaikojen ulkopuolella.

**Myyntihenkisyyttä, verkostoja ja paikallistuntemusta:**

Uusasiakashankinta ja uusien toimeksiantojen hankkiminen ovat olennainen osa työtä. Saat yritykseltä valmiita toimeksiantoja hoidettavaksi, mutta odotamme sinulta myös aktiivista otetta asiakaskunnan ja toimeksiantokannan kasvattamiseen. Nautit ihmisten kanssa toimimisesta, osaat rakentaa luottamusta ja tunnet alueen tai olet valmis oppimaan sen nopeasti.

**LKV- tai LVV-pätevyys katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole tehtävän edellytys:**

Voit siis hakea tehtävään myös ilman alan pätevyyttä tai aikaisempaa kokemusta kiinteistönvälityksestä. Tärkeintä meille ovat oikea asenne, omatoimisuus, tarkkuus ja halu oppia.

**B-ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta:**

Työ edellyttää liikkumista asiakastapaamisissa, kohteilla ja esittelyissä, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on tehtävän edellytys.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

**Tule tekemään tulosta tiimiin, jossa töitä on valmiina, saat vahvan tuen tekemiseesi ja onnistumisesta myös palkitaan.**

jobs.title: Contract Manager
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. Our green steel production in Boden will be powered by one of the world’s largest green hydrogen plants, running on renewable electricity. Instead of emitting large amounts of CO₂, as in traditional steelmaking processes, our primary emission will be water. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. The facility will impact, and shape, the surroundings as well as the perception of Boden, with the aim that it will be seen as a symbol for the much-needed green transition of heavy industry.

The Contract Manager is an active and engaged team member within the Contract Management team in support of both Project Leads, Construction Managers and other stakeholders. The role will be a direct report to the Lead Contract Manager / Head of Contracts and with a functionally to the Site Construction Manager / Area Manager.

Responsibilities

·      Manages Site Contractors in terms of contract management and administration

·      Work as part of an integrated cross-functional Site team

·      Address contractual and commercial risks and identifying and implementing mitigation measures

·      Ensure a flexibility approach whilst adhering to requirements and standards

·      Support the Project Site and Contract Management teams in defining contracting strategies

·      Support of processing and enforcement of Change Requests, Change Orders and claims

·      Participation in the reviewing and examination of contracts in support of contract negotiations

·      Coordination and alignment with other contract managers

·      Ensuring the uniform interpretation of contractual clauses and treatment of Change Requests, Change Orders, claims and implementation of lessons learned

·      Support of Project Site and Contract Management teams regarding contractual issues and correspondence (externally as well as internally)

·      Interface with other departments such as Legal, Engineering, Finance, Technical, etc.

·      Provide support on contractual issues, risk and opportunities and assistance in the identification, capture, analysis, mitigation and tracking of project risks

·      Ensuring working in compliance with policies, procedures and systems (ACC, GEP and others).

Qualifications

·      Minimum 10 years of experience as a Contract Manager on major construction projects.

·      Legal, commercial, and/or technical background with a university degree or equivalent qualification; legal and commercial expertise is preferred.

·      Open, articulate, and transparent, with clear and concise communication skills, both verbal and written.

·      Highly engaged and detail-oriented.

·      Experience from Scandinavian projects is considered an advantage.

·      Strong proficiency in Swedish, both written and spoken is considered an advantage

jobs.title: Biluthyrare
jobs.description:
Låt oss skapa framtidens mobilitet tillsammans!

Din Bil, en del av Porsche Holding Salzburg GmbH och Volkswagen AG, är en ledande aktör i den svenska bilbranschen med märken som Volkswagen, Audi, Seat, Škoda, CUPRA, Porsche, Volkswagen transportbilar och Europcar. Med 68 anläggningar och cirka 2400 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, västra Skåne samt Gävleborg-Dalarna erbjuder vi karriärmöjligheter inom försäljning, service, verkstad och administrativa roller. Vår värdegrund, som betonar driv, integritet och hållbarhet, främjar en inkluderande och dynamisk arbetsplats. Vi satsar på medarbetarutveckling och en hälsosam arbetsmiljö. Om du delar vår vision och har de kvaliteter vi söker, så är du precis den personen vi vill ha ombord. Välkommen till Din Bil!

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på obestämd tid med start från 1/9 eller efter överenskommelse. Anställningens omfattning och upplägg kan komma att anpassas utifrån verksamhetens säsongsbehov i Sälen under perioden december–april. Tjänsten innebär arbete på kvällar och helger.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Som biluthyrare för Europcar i Mora kommer du ta hand om de kunder som besöker eller kontaktar oss gällande biluthyrning.
    Du tar emot bokningar, färdigställer bilarna, hanterar betalning och administration.
    Detta innebär ett omväxlande arbete där du arbetar nära kunden för att ge en service i toppklass.

Vem är du?

    Vi söker dig som är driven, engagerad och har en stark känsla för kundnöjdhet samt en förmåga att självständigt organisera och prioritera ditt arbete arbetet.
    Du har en positiv inställning samt bred social kompetens. Du bör trivas i en självständig roll med högt tempo.
    Vi söker dig som har minst ett par års arbetserfarenhet av serviceyrket gärna inom vår bransch.
    Du har goda kunskaper i Office-paketet samt kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska. Avslutad gymnasieutbildning och B-körkort är ett krav.

Vårt erbjudande till dig

Hälsa och friskvård

Kollektivavtal

Utbildning

Trygg arbetsmiljö

Redo för nästa steg?

Vi ser fram emot att veta mer om dig i din ansökan. I denna rekrytering kommer stor vikt läggs vid dina personliga egenskaper och ditt engagemang. Rekryteringen sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Din Bil eftersträvar jämställdhet och mångfald. Vi värdesätter de kvaliteter som en jämn könsfördelning samt etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför en verksamhet.

Är det dig vi letar efter? Då är du välkommen med din ansökan senast 31/8. Din Bil Sverige genomför enligt gällande rekryteringsprocess i samtliga rekryteringar en kontroll av CV/Meritförteckning, vitsord och vandelsprövning innan anställning.

För frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Sofia Sundlöf Belin, sofia.sundlof@dinbil.se eller station ansvarig - Marco Kristoffersson, marco.kristoffersson@dinbil.se

jobs.title: Manager Data Governance
jobs.description:
Join us to deliver a smoke-free future as a Manager Data Governance!

We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.



In the Nordic region, we are 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.



Role Summary

As Manager Data Governance, you will play a key leadership role in enabling the organization to treat data as a trusted, consistent, and secure strategic asset. You will act as a connector between business and technology and promote strong data governance practices across the Nordic region. You will ensure they align with enterprise standards and meet local business needs.



In this role, you will drive the change to a results-focused data approach. You will encourage collaborators to own data assets and assist them with understanding and applying governance frameworks. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that data is defined, managed, and used in a way that creates value, supports decision-making, and strengthens compliance.



Key Responsibilities

    Drive the adoption of data governance frameworks across the Nordic organization, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards
    Act as a trusted partner to business and IT stakeholders to align data definitions, processes, and technical implementation
    Lead cross-functional collaboration to resolve data definition conflicts and ensure consistency across markets
    Establish and maintain clear data ownership, accountability, and governance structures
    Facilitate governance forums and decision-making processes to prioritize and resolve data-related topics
    Promote a culture of data ownership and quality through training, communication, and stakeholder engagement
    Monitor and report on data quality, governance maturity, and adoption of standards
    Identify gaps in policies or standards and drive continuous improvement and value creation through data governance initiatives.



Who You Are

    You bring at least 5 years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, or a related field
    You have a strong understanding of business processes and how data supports decision-making across functions
    You are comfortable navigating complex topics (e.g. data architecture, data quality, data privacy) and translating them into clear, practical guidance
    You are a structured and proactive collaborator with strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
    You enjoy working in cross-functional, international environments and building alignment across diverse perspectives
    You are a strong communicator, fluent in English (Swedish is considered a plus)



Why join us?

You will be part of a transformation where data is at the center of how the organization creates value. This role allows you to invent how data is managed and used throughout the Nordics. You will engage with leaders across commercial and technical domains and deliver meaningful, enduring impact.



All applicants must have the legal right to work in Sweden.



Please note that relocation support is not available for this job.



What we offer

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:



    Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.
    Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.
    Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.
    Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.
    Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

jobs.title: Primary IT-Säljare med fokus på molntjänster AI och säkerhet
jobs.description:
Sälj det som faktiskt förändrar hur företag fungerar. Bygg din portfölj. Lev på resultaten.

Primary Group AB söker en ambitiös B2B-säljare som vill vara med och driva digitaliseringen av svenska företag — med AI, IT och kommunikation i samma erbjudande.

Framtiden säljs redan. Frågan är om du är med.

AI-agenter som hanterar kundservice. Molntjänster som ersätter lokala servrar. Kommunikationslösningar som samlar hela teamet i ett system. CRM-plattformar som gör säljarens vardag smidigare.

Det är inte framtidens lösningar. Det är verkligheten för svenska företag idag — och efterfrågan accelererar.

Primary Group säljer hela spektrumet av lösningar som moderna företag behöver för att fungera och växa. Vi söker nu en person som vill vara den som hjälper dem att ta steget.

Vad du säljer

Du arbetar med ett av marknadens bredaste erbjudanden för B2B:

    AI-agenter för företag — intelligenta agenter som automatiserar kundservice, sälj, administration och interna arbetsflöden. En AI-agent kan ta emot och svara på kundförfrågningar dygnet runt, boka möten automatiskt och kvalificera leads innan de når säljteamet — utan att en enda människa behöver vara inblandad.
    IT och IT-hårdvara — arbetsplatslösningar, servrar, nätverk och kringutrustning
    Telekom och företagskommunikation — moderna kommunikationslösningar för team
    Molntjänster — skalbar, säker infrastruktur i molnet
    Företagsväxlar och moderna kommunikationslösningar — unified communications för det moderna kontoret
    CRM och affärssystem — digitalt stöd för sälj, service och drift
    Webb och digitala tjänster — digital närvaro och e-handelsplattformar
    Finansiering av företagets tekniska investeringar — gör investeringen möjlig direkt

En kund. Åtta produktområden. Det är inte bara en bredare affär — det är en djupare relation.

Det här gör oss annorlunda: AI som konkret affärsmöjlighet

Vi är inne i ett paradigmskifte. AI-agenter går från buzzword till vardagsverktyg hos svenska bolag. Primary Group är positionerat för att möta den efterfrågan — vi levererar skräddarsydda AI-lösningar som faktiskt implementeras och används.

Som säljare hos oss säljer du inte "AI i allmänhet". Du säljer specifika lösningar som förändrar hur ett företag fungerar i praktiken. En AI-agent kan automatiskt hantera inkommande kundärenden och svara på vanliga frågor utan väntetid. Den kan kvalificera och prioritera leads åt säljteamet, boka möten direkt i kalendern och skicka orderbekräftelser — allt utan mänsklig inblandning. En annan agent kan sköta hela orderflödet i en webbutik, från förfrågan till leveransbesked. Det är en affär med substans — och med ett growing market bakom sig.

Det marknadsfönster som nu öppnat sig är verkligt: företag som kommer igång med AI tidigt bygger ett försprång som är svårt att ta igen. Att vara den säljare som hjälper dem att ta det steget är ett av de starkaste positionerna du kan ha just nu.

Inkomstpotential som faktiskt speglar din insats. Provisionsbaserad modell med möjlighet till fast grundlön. Ditt tak sätter du själv — och med vår produktbredd finns det alltid fler affärer att göra med varje befintlig kund.

Din egen kundportfölj. Du bygger successivt upp en kundstock som tillhör dig. Varje kund du vinner är en plattform för framtida merförsäljning. Det är inte ett jobb — det är ett ägarskap i din egen säljbok.

Produkter med verklig efterfrågan.Digitalisering, AI och molntjänster är inte säljargument — de är nödvändigheter för moderna företag. Du säljer lösningar som kunderna aktivt söker.

Vi lever som vi lär.Vi använder AI-verktyg internt i vår egen verksamhet. Du säljer inte bara AI till kunder — du arbetar dagligen i en organisation som tillämpar det, och du ser med egna ögon vilken skillnad det gör.

Snabb organisation.Vi är en entrepreneurdriven organisation med korta beslutsvägar. Dina idéer tas emot, feedback tas på allvar och du slipper vänta månader på svar uppifrån.

Vem vi söker

Vi söker dig som brinner för att skapa affärer och vill bygga något på riktigt. Bakgrund spelar roll — men driv och resultatfokus spelar mer.

Du passar om du:

    Har erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning (IT, telekom, SaaS, finans eller liknande är meriterande)
    Är självgående, strukturerad och trivs med att driva processer framåt

Vill du ha ett vanligt säljarjobb finns det många att välja mellan.

jobs.description:
Company Description

About Campos Coffee

Founded in 2002, Campos Coffee is the leading specialty coffee brand in Australia. Our values go beyond a great cup of coffee â we care about quality, integrity and nurturing long-term relationships with our coffee producers, customers and our staff. Our iconic green cup is a catalyst for connection and growth, a symbol of our obsession with quality and service across everything we do. This is backed by our consecutive position as AICA Champion Australian Roaster for 2022.

Find out more about the Campos Coffee at camposcoffee.com

Job Description

As a Campos Coffee Roaster, youâll ensure that our coffee is roasted accurately and to schedule, to deliver consistent flavours and satisfy customer demands. This role is based at Campos HQ in Banksmeadow, where we roast our beans daily! You will be scheduled to work either a standard shift from Monday to Friday, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM, or a floater shift starting between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM and finishing between 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM, depending on operational requirements. Flexibility is essential, and occasional (paid) overtime may be offered.

In This Role, Youâll Have The Ability To

  • Roast coffee according to the required sensory profile.
  • Work closely with other teams to ensure all roasts are ready in time.
  • Minimise wastage.
  • Follow Safety and Quality protocols.
  • Learn about coffees (origins, roast profiles, tastes) from our coffee experts and join regular cupping sessions.

Qualifications

As a Campos Roaster, youâll seriously care about doing a great job. Youâll love contributing to the team and the company, and youâre passionate about providing outstanding customer service.

For this role as a Roaster, weâre looking for someone who has the following skills and experience:

  • You are detail oriented.
  • You can focus well, and you do not get distracted during work.
  • You are open to doing repetitive work.
  • You love coffee and are excited to learn how to roast the Campos way.
  • You have basic computer skills including MS Word, Excel, Outlook, and teams.
  • You are willing and physically fit enough to lift to 24 kg (weâll teach you how).
  • You have valid AU working rights with unlimited working rights.

Additional Information

Whatâs in it for you?

  • Support, training and an onboarding program
  • A wealth of knowledge of coffee to tap into and a shared love for coffee
  • Delicious coffee on-site and Campos coffee discounts
  • Access two days of special events leave per year to utilise for your birthday, school events, volunteering, or more!
  • Free parking is available on site with limited availability, but free street parking is also available!
  • Join in on social events such as our annual end of year celebrations, STEPtember, team lunches and more!

Why Campos?

Do Quality Work, With People Who Care

If youâre passionate about specialty coffee â or if you just seriously care about being the best you can be â youâll find like-minded souls here.

Be you and belong

Campos is a great blend of personalities and lives. What unites us is a real commitment to consistency, quality and authenticity.

Have impact, beyond your role

Whatever you do at Campos, youâll be growing something good. Our work positively affects local and global communitiesâ¦ and as we grow, so does our impact.

Grow your story with ours

Our future success depends on the quality and commitment of our team. We nurture great people - because as you grow and thrive, so will we.

If you think you're up for a new challenge just like this, please grab a cuppa, brush up your CV and apply now (it's really easy, we promise).

Campos is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate and value our differences and are committed to building a safe and inclusive work environment where everyone can be their true selves. Do not hesitate to reach out if you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process.

JDE Peetâs - now part of Keurig Dr Pepper â is the worldâs leading pure-play coffee company, with a presence in more than 100 markets. Guided by our âReignite the Amazingâ strategy, we are focused on brand-led growth across three big bets: Peetâs, LâOR, and our 10 strategically selected local icons led by Jacobs.

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description:
Vanajaveden Opisto on vireä ja monialainen kansalaisopisto, joka toimii Hämeenlinnan seudulla ja on osa Koulutuskuntayhtymä Tavastiaa,https://www.kktavastia.fi/vanajaveden-opisto/ [vop.fi](https://www.kktavastia.fi/vanajaveden-opisto/).

Haluatko innostaa lapsia liikkumaan ja ohjata heitä kohti liikunnallista elämäntapaa? Etsimme energistä ja vastuullista liikunnanohjaajaa (tai useampaa) Hämeenlinnan kouluilla järjestettäviin Harrastus ihan lähellä – kerhoihin määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 1.9.2026–7.5.2027. Työtunteja on tarjolla n. 2–15 h / vko, riippuen ohjattavien kerhojen määrästä. Lisäksi tehtävään voidaan yhdistää myös aikuisliikunnan ohjausta. Työnkuva sopii hyvin lisätyöksi tai opintojen oheen.

Kerhoja järjestetään laajalla alueella eri puolilla Hämeenlinnaa, joten oma auto on lähes välttämätön. Kerhot ajoittuvat tyypillisesti klo 13–17 välille.

Liikunnanohjaajana vastaat liikuntakerhojen suunnittelusta ja ohjaamisesta. Tavoitteena on tarjota lapsille monipuolisia, turvallisia ja innostavia matalan kynnyksen liikuntakerhoja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointia ja aktiivista elämäntapaa. Työtehtäviin kuuluu liikuntakerhojen suunnittelu ja toteutus, lasten ohjaaminen ja kannustaminen liikunnan pariin sekä turvallisesta toimintaympäristöstä huolehtiminen.

Odotamme sinulta kokemusta liikunnan ohjaamisesta, innostavaa ja kannustavaa työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja, kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja vastuullisesti sekä soveltuvaa koulutusta tai alan opintoja.

Tarjoamme merkityksellisen työn lasten hyvinvoinnin edistämisessä, mukavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön ja mahdollisuuden toteuttaa oman näköisiä liikuntakerhoja omia vahvuuksiasi ja mielenkiinnon kohteita hyödyntäen. Palkkaus ja muut palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät KVTES:in mukaan.

HAKEMINEN

Hakemukset sähköisellä lomakkeella 26.8.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä. Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, mahdollisesti jo hakuajan kuluessa.

LISÄTIEDOT

aamu- ja iltapäivätoiminnan koordinaattori Erkka Nurminen, puh. 040 450 6646, erkka.nurminen@kktavastia.fi

Koulutuskuntayhtymä Tavastia arvostaa yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössä. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri taustoista tulevia henkilöitä – eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuolta olevia sekä eri kieli-, kulttuuri- ja vähemmistöryhmiin kuuluvia.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Developer 💻
jobs.description:
About the role Wrknest is looking for a Senior Frontend Developer on behalf of a global technology company with an established presence in Stockholm. The company develops advanced hardware and software solutions that make it easier for organizations to manage connected devices, networks and physical environments.

In this role, you will join a product-focused development team working on modern, highly interactive web applications. Your focus will be on creating responsive and intuitive user experiences using React and TypeScript, while also contributing to frontend architecture, code quality and technical decisions.

The role combines hands-on development with close collaboration across engineering, product and design. You will work with everything from reusable UI components and complex visualizations to AI-assisted development workflows, giving you the opportunity to influence both the product and how the team builds it.

Your future responsibilities

As a Senior Frontend Developer, you will take an active role throughout the development process. You will build new functionality, improve existing interfaces and help ensure that the frontend remains scalable, maintainable and performant as the product evolves.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Developing and maintaining modular and reusable React components

    

Building responsive and intuitive user interfaces

    

Collaborating with designers and product managers to improve UI and UX and shape new user flows

    

Developing scalable visualization components for device relationships, floorplans and system topologies

    

Writing and maintaining tests to ensure quality and reliability

    

Contributing to frontend architecture and participating in design and code reviews

    

Working with AI-assisted development workflows, including reusable AI skills, agent definitions and specifications

    

Reviewing and validating AI-generated code to ensure correctness and maintainability

    

Continuously improving frontend performance, responsiveness and development practices

About you

To succeed in this role, you have solid professional experience in frontend development and are comfortable taking ownership of technically complex features.

Requirements:

    

At least 5 years of professional experience in frontend development or a similar role

    

Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript

    

Extensive experience working with React

    

Strong understanding of programming principles, design patterns, modern web protocols and web security

    

Experience analysing and troubleshooting technical issues

    

A strong understanding of clean code, frontend performance and optimization

    

Experience integrating AI-assisted workflows into frontend development, such as code review, test generation or automation

    

Experience creating and maintaining executable specifications or living documentation alongside evolving code

    

Familiarity with Model Context Protocol, MCP, and connecting AI tooling with internal systems

    

Experience using AI-assisted code review as part of a development workflow

Nice to have:

    

Experience with Node.js, other programming languages or full-stack development

    

Experience with Redux, React-Redux or redux-saga

    

Experience with styled-components or similar styling solutions

    

Experience with Jest or other frontend testing frameworks

    

Experience working with multimedia such as video, audio or image optimization

    

Experience developing interfaces for networking, mobile or IoT products

    

Experience with visualization libraries for topology maps, hierarchical graphs or interactive layouts

    

Experience implementing interactive UI functionality such as zooming, panning, snapping or node-link editing

You enjoy solving complex technical problems and care about the details that make an interface both intuitive and reliable. You are comfortable discussing technical decisions with others, reviewing different approaches and taking responsibility for the quality of what reaches the end user.

Other information

Start: According to agreement

Location: Central Stockholm, with a hybrid working model

Employment type: Recruitment through Wrknest, with direct employment at the client company

The position includes a competitive compensation package with benefits such as a wellness allowance, occupational pension, health and insurance coverage, five weeks of annual leave and flexible working hours.

A background check will be conducted during the final stage of the recruitment process.

About the client

The client is an international technology company developing integrated hardware and software products for connected environments. Their solutions are used globally across businesses and other organizations, with a focus on making advanced technology easier to deploy, manage and scale.

The Stockholm team works in an international product environment where software, hardware, design and product development come together. As part of the team, you will have the opportunity to work on products with a large global user base while contributing directly to their continued technical development.

About Wrknest Engineering

Wrknest Engineering specializes in helping engineers and technicians take the next step in their careers. We work with the companies of the future and offer both recruitment and consulting assignments within engineering and industry, always with people at the center.

We believe in building long-term relationships and strive to be a committed and attentive partner. Through us, you have the opportunity to be part of the technological advancements shaping tomorrow’s society – in roles where your expertise makes a real difference.

Our ambition is for you to enjoy your work, grow professionally, and feel proud of what you do. Learn more at www.wrknestengineering.se.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Manager to high-tech company
jobs.description:
Are you a Manufacturing Manager ready to lead performance, drive efficiency, and strengthen industrial execution?

The company is a global leader in their field with 15,000 employees globally. They have been at the forefront of innovation, continuously pushing boundaries. Their diversified portfolio serves a variety of applications in government and private sector.

We are looking for an experienced Manufacturing Manager in Arninge/Täby. This is a key leadership role within manufacturing, responsible for driving operational performance, strengthening execution, and supporting continued growth in production capability for their high-performance systems.

The role includes leadership of assemblers, testers, warehouse personnel, and production planners, as well as close collaboration with R&D and other support functions to improve products, processes, and industrialization.

What the company offers

    

A Friendly and Inclusive Culture: Join a team that values collaboration, problem-solving, and creativity.

    

Global Team: Work alongside passionate colleagues from around the world.

    

Great Team and Culture: Collaborate with other talented engineers in a supportive environment.

    

Financially Stable and Growing Company: Be part of a company that is financially secure and expanding.

    

Healthcare Benefits: Access to healthcare benefits, free gym, and various sports activities.

Your Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and develop a manufacturing organization of approximately 25 employees, including assemblers, testers, warehouse workers, and production planners.

    

Ensure achievement of production targets in volume, quality, and delivery by maintaining the right staffing, competencies, and daily priorities.

    

Drive efficient ways of working and implement best practices to improve manufacturing efficiency and increase production output.

    

Lead daily operational meetings, remove roadblocks, and report manufacturing status, risks, and priorities to the leadership team.

    

Work cross-functionally with R&D, quality, supply chain, and production engineering to identify improvement opportunities and support stronger product industrialization.

    

Foster a motivated, accountable, and collaborative team culture with strong focus on safety, quality, and work environment.

What We’re Looking For

    

7+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, or operations leadership.

    

Proven experience leading teams and delivering against production, quality, and operational targets.

    

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, material flow, and performance management.

    

Experience improving manufacturing efficiency, implementing best practices, and increasing production output.

    

Experience working cross-functionally with R&D, quality, supply chain, production engineering, and manufacturing strategy.

    

Experience with serial production, and assembly of electrical/electronics and/or optical products is a plus.

    

Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

    

Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English, written and spoken.

    

Structured, proactive, and results-oriented approach.

Additional Qualifications (Good To Have)

    

Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing.

    

Experience with SAP

    

Experience with PLM systems, such as PTC Windchill or Siemens Teamcenter.

    

Degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, industrial management, or related field.

Security & Eligibility Requirements

Due to the nature of our work in the defense sector:

    

You must be eligible to work in Sweden and pass a security background check and be eligible for U.S. export control licenses (ITAR/EAR).

Other information:  Start: As per agreement  Location: Täby  Scope: Fulltime  This is a direct employment with our customer, salary and benefits will be dicussed seperately.
