jobs.description:
Stillingen innebærer arbeid med barn og ungdom, og du vil være en viktig voksenperson i deres hverdag. Som miljøarbeider skal du bidra til trygghet, aktivitet, inkludering og gode relasjoner. Arbeidet vil være variert og innebære både planlagte aktiviteter og oppfølging av beboerne i det daglige.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet. Vi ønsker oss en medarbeider som:

  • møter barn og unge med varme, respekt og tydelighet

  • er stabil og ansvarsbevisst

  • ser den enkelte og er opptatt av barnas beste

  • har godt humør og evne til å skape aktivitet og engasjement

  • håndterer uforutsette situasjoner på en rolig måte

  • kan arbeide selvstendig, men også godt i team

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Følge opp barn og unge i mottaket

  • Være en trygg og tilgjengelig voksenperson

  • Bidra til lek, fritidsaktiviteter, idrett og andre sosiale tiltak

  • Legge til rette for mestring, inkludering og sosial tilhørighet

  • Bidra til gode rutiner og struktur i barnas og ungdommenes hverdag

  • Observere og følge opp behov hos barn og unge

  • Ha dialog og samarbeid med foreldre/foresatte og øvrige ansatte

  • Bidra til et trygt og godt bomiljø på mottaket

  • Dokumentere og rapportere i henhold til mottakets rutiner

  • Delta i praktiske oppgaver knyttet til miljøarbeidet

Arbeidsoppgavene kan endres etter behov og i takt med mottakets drift.

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har et genuint engasjement for barn og ungdom

  • Er trygg, tålmodig og tydelig i møte med mennesker

  • Er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner

  • Evner å sette grenser på en trygg og respektfull måte

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med en variert arbeidshverdag

  • Har respekt for mennesker med ulik kulturell og språklig bakgrunn

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk

Vi tilbyr

  • 50 % fast stilling

  • En meningsfull og samfunnsviktig jobb

  • Mulighet til å gjøre en positiv forskjell for barn og unge

  • Et inkluderende og tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver

  • Opplæring og støtte i arbeidet

  • Lønn, pensjon- og arbeidsvilkår etter tariff

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kompella AS er et heleid kommunalt eiendomsselskap. P.t. er det 20 fast ansatte i selskapet. Vi forvalter, drifter og vedlikeholder en variert bygningsmasse i tillegg til drift av asylmottak.

Kvæfjord mottak

Kvæfjord mottak skal bidra til å gjøre en ny fremtid mulig for mennesker på flukt. Vi har over 25 års erfaring med drift av mottak, asylsøkere og flyktninger. Kvæfjord mottak har i dag 200 ordinære plasser, et flerkulturelt, mangfoldig og godt arbeidsmiljø og er en av de større driftsoperatørene i regionen. På vår arbeidsplass utfører våre kolleger viktige samfunnsoppgaver. Mange av de menneskene vi møter i vårt arbeid er i en sårbar livssituasjon, noe som stiller store krav til vår kompetanse, våre holdninger og vår profesjonalitet

Oppdraget løses på vegne av Utlendingsdirektoratet (Udi). Mottaket har i dag 14 ansatte og er bemannet 365 dager i året. Gjennom utstrakt miljøarbeid bidrar vi til å gi beboerne nødvendig omsorg og trygghet.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java) to Mycronic
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 40 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. If you have several years of work experience within software development and embedded systems and wants to be part of a growing company with world leading products, this is for you!

About the role

Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. Mycronic is divided into four divisions, and in this role, you will belong to PCB Assembly Solutions (PA). PA is a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT) to electronics manufacturers who require rapid production adjustments while maintaining high efficiency. PA delivers systems for circuit board assembly, including both complete line solutions and individual systems for specific process steps, as well as advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. In this role, you will be part of a team of 7 team members and collaborate with several functions across the company, such as architects, project managers and other software teams within for example AI.

You are offered

    The opportunity to work in a multi-cultural company with knowledgeable, friendly and goal-oriented colleagues.
    To work in an exciting company in a growth phase, where you can make a real impact in a fun and dynamic environment. Mycronic is a global company, yet small enough for you to truly make a difference.
    The opportunity to work with world-leading products. The future of electronics production is increasingly complex. Denser boards, a wider range of miniaturized components, more NPIs and erratic production schedules. To address these challenges Mycronic has developed the industry’s fastest, most flexible and most precise jet printing and solder paste dispensing systems. Mycronic jet printing technology makes it possible to dispense solder paste for the most challenging circuit boards and components, with micrometer accuracy, maximum speed and perfect quality solder joints. Read more here: https://www.mycronic.com/product-areas/pcb-assembly/products/smt/jet-printing/.
    Mycronic has a large software organization which will provide you with optimal opportunities to develop your knowledge in various areas of computer science – such as software architecture for robotics, machine learning, AI, optimization, and computer vision.

Work tasks

You will work in a broad developer role where you will truly have the opportunity to influence the final solution of the products. The Mycronic Jet Printer, which is the product area you will be developing the software for, includes electronics, mechanics, and software, creating exciting opportunities for those who want to work with complex software development involving multiple technical disciplines. We are continuously working to enhance our products; user-friendliness, particularly in terms of automation and user interfaces, which will also be part of your development work. Your primary focus will be on improving the products, with opportunities to contribute your ideas and collaborate as a team to create the best solutions. This may involve anything from adding capability features and reducing energy consumption to updating the GUI. Mycronic has both R&D, lab, and production in-house, meaning you will work close to the products you develop, which also gives you the opportunity to see the "real world" results of your work.

We are looking for

This is a role for someone with a strong background in software development and an interest in understanding the entire product and an ambition to grow into a software architect role. As a software developer you will have a key role in the product development since this is where all the technology in the machine comes together to provide the system functionality that meets the user. You will be involved in everything from requirements gathering to design, architecture and development and collaborate with several stakeholders. As a person, we see it as particularly important that you are goal- and detail-oriented and have strong collaboration skills. You also have a will to contribute with your ideas, and just like your colleagues, you always strive to develop yourself and contribute to the team´s collective growth. We expect you to make a strong contribution by adding new functionality, maintaining high quality and by helping to introduce new technology and processes to increase team efficiency.

You likely have:

    A master´s degree within computer science, electronics, mechatronics or similar.
    Strong software development experience with the capability and ambition to take on broader architectural responsibilities in a few years.
    Strong knowledge in Java.
    Strong knowledge of software development in Linux.
    Experience of working with software systems that interact with embedded software and hardware.
    Strong knowledge in English and good knowledge in Swedish (or have the desire to learn)

It is considered advantageous if you have...

    Knowledge in C and/or C++

Other Information

    Start date: By agreement
    Employment type: Permanent
    Scope: Full-time
    Location: Kista
    Contact Information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se
    The recruitment process is handled by Academic Work, and Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the process goes to Academic Work.

Our recruitment process

    Problem-solving and personality test
    Phone interview with Academic Work
    In-depth interview with Academic Work
    Interviews with Mycronic
    Reference check + decision

jobs.title: Camper Rental Station Manager - Oslo (Near Gardermoen Airport)
jobs.description:
Station Manager -- Oslo (Near Gardermoen Airport)

Arctic Campers AS is looking for an experienced, motivated, and hands-on Station Manager to take responsibility for the daily operation of our Oslo station, located close to Gardermoen Airport.

As Station Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that customers receive an outstanding experience, employees have the support they need to succeed, and our fleet of camper vans is always prepared to the highest standard.

This is a leadership position for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, leading people by example, and being actively involved in the daily operation rather than managing only from an office.

The position is full-time and starts at the beginning of January.

Training

Before taking over responsibility for the Oslo station, you will complete a mandatory 2.5 month training program at our headquarters in Tromsø.

During this period you will learn every aspect of our operation, including:

  • Customer service and camper van handovers

  • Fleet preparation and quality control

  • Vehicle logistics

  • Camper van equipment and technical systems

  • Daily station management

  • Company procedures and operational standards

Accommodation during the training period in Tromsø will be provided by Arctic Campers.

Our working language is English, and you will become part of an international team consisting of colleagues from many different countries.

Educational and Skill Requirements

  • Previous leadership or management experience is an advantage

  • A minimum of 10 years of work experience in any profession is considered a strong advantage

  • Experience from tourism, vehicle rental, hospitality, logistics, automotive, or a similar industry is preferred

  • Experience leading and developing employees is an advantage

  • Interest in camper vans, tourism, and customer service

  • Basic technical understanding of vehicles or camper vans is an advantage

  • Valid Category B driver's licence (BE licence is an advantage)

  • Excellent English language skills (additional languages are an advantage)

  • Strong organizational and communication skills

  • Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style

  • Positive attitude, honesty, reliability, and willingness to take responsibility

Main Responsibilities

  • Managing the daily operation of the Oslo station

  • Leading, motivating, and supporting the station team

  • Onboarding, training, and supervising permanent and seasonal employees

  • Participating in the daily operation alongside your team whenever required

  • Ensuring professional customer service and high-quality camper van handovers

  • Planning and coordinating daily staffing and operational activities

  • Maintaining an overview of the camper van fleet together with the Head of Operations and Fleet Manager

  • Coordinating vehicle movements between stations and workshops

  • Ensuring all camper vans meet Arctic Campers' quality standards before every rental

  • Monitoring and maintaining the station's technical equipment, tools, and facilities

  • Supporting troubleshooting of camper van equipment and coordinating repairs when necessary

  • Ensuring company procedures, safety standards, and operational routines are followed

  • Reporting operational performance, challenges, and improvement opportunities to management

  • Continuously improving station efficiency and customer satisfaction

  • Performing other operational and administrative tasks as required

Working Hours

This is a full-time permanent position.

Working hours are scheduled according to operational requirements and will include weekends and public holidays during the rental season.

Working Permit

Arctic Campers AS welcomes applications from both Norwegian residents and international candidates.

  • Norwegian citizens: No work permit is required.

  • EU/EEA citizens: We will assist with the necessary paperwork required to register and work legally in Norway.

  • Non-EU/EEA citizens: We do not sponsor work visas or residence permits. Applicants who require visa sponsorship are unfortunately not eligible for this position and should not apply.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers AS is one of Norway's largest camper van rental companies, with stations in Tromsø and Oslo. Every year we welcome thousands of travellers from all over the world who choose our custom-built camper vans to explore Norway's spectacular landscapes.

We are a young, international company where teamwork, responsibility, and continuous improvement are highly valued. We believe that great customer experiences begin with great employees, and we are looking for a Station Manager who shares that mindset.

If you are looking for a challenging leadership position where no two days are the same, enjoy working with people, and want to be part of an ambitious and growing company, we would love to hear from you.

Venealan aiempi kokemus on plussaa tähä tehtävään, mutta tärkeintä on oikea asenne ja kiinnostus tekniikkaan. Venealan kokemuksen lisäksi tehtävään sopii erinomaisesti esimerkiksi autonasentajan taustalla oleva tekijä tai henkilö, jolla on kokemusta erilaisten moottorikäyttöisten laitteiden huoltamisesta ja korjaamisesta. Jos moottorit, mekaniikka ja käsillä tekeminen ovat sinun juttusi, tässä voisi olla seuraava työpaikkasi.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Kokemusta veneistä ja niiden mekaniikasta tai vahvaa mekaanista osaamista esimerkiksi autonasentajan tehtävistä

\- Kokemusta moottorikäyttöisten laitteiden huoltamisesta ja korjaamisesta

\- Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta

\- Joustavuutta ja halua oppia uutta

\- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä

jobs.title: Teradata Architect
jobs.description:
About Cognizant

Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping organizations modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world. With over 300,000 associates globally, Cognizant combines a passion for client satisfaction, technology innovation, deep industry and business process expertise, and a global, collaborative workforce that embodies the future of work. We are consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world and among the best companies to work for. Our culture is built on a foundation of transparency, inclusion, and collaboration — empowering our people to grow and thrive both professionally and personally. At Cognizant, you won't just be part of a company; you'll be part of a community that is shaping the future of industries across the globe.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Teradata Architect with strong Snowflake expertise to lead and drive a large-scale data warehouse transformation within the banking sector. In this role, you will be responsible for guiding the migration from legacy Teradata environments to a modern Snowflake-based cloud data platform, ensuring a smooth, efficient, and scalable transition.

The role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, architectural thinking, and hands-on involvement, along with the ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and business teams.

Location: Stockholm

Key Responsibilities

You will take ownership of understanding the current Teradata data warehouse landscape and play a central role in driving its migration to Snowflake. This includes reviewing and validating the end-to-end migration strategy and identifying areas for improvement or optimization.

You will support the design and evolution of the target Snowflake architecture, including storage, compute, and security layers, ensuring alignment with business and technical requirements. A key part of the role is working closely with engineering teams to convert Teradata SQL, stored procedures, and macros into Snowflake-compatible solutions, while refactoring scripts for improved performance and scalability.

You will collaborate with data engineers, cloud architects, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment across the transformation initiative. In addition, you will provide technical leadership and mentorship, helping to guide teams through the migration and build best-practice capabilities.

The role also includes working with existing security and access control frameworks, translating current role-based access models into the Snowflake environment, and ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and compliance standards.

Core Requirements

You bring strong experience in Teradata architecture and data warehousing, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL across both Teradata and Snowflake environments. You have hands-on experience working with Snowflake and a solid understanding of how to migrate, transform, and optimize data warehouse solutions in a cloud context.

You have experience leading or playing a key role in at least one full-scale data warehouse migration and are comfortable working in complex transformation environments where both legacy and modern platforms coexist.

Desirable Skills

Experience working with ETL tools is valuable, with familiarity in platforms such as IDMC considered an advantage. You bring a collaborative mindset and are used to working in cross-functional teams, contributing not only to technical delivery but also to overall solution design and continuous improvement.

About Cognizant:

Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is an AI Builder and technology services provider, bridging the gap between AI investment and enterprise value by building full-stack AI solutions for our clients. Our deep industry, process and engineering expertise enables us to build an organization’s unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, drive tangible outcomes and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. See how at cognizant.ai or @cognizant.

Additional employment information

Compensation information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Applicants may be required to attend interviews in person or by video conference. In addition, candidates may be required to present their current state or government issued ID during each interview.

Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. Your application and candidacy will not be considered based on race, color, sex, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Both research assistant positions will focus on development of AI-based decision support. One position will be related to a joint project with Hospital Sønderjylland (Sønderborg) on personalized cardiovascular risk prediction and diagnostic support for patients with advanced kidney disease. The other position will be related to a joint project with Lillebælt Hospital (Vejle) on detection of smoking status and symptoms for lung cancer patients.

 

Ideal candidates

To qualify for the positions, you must hold a M.Sc. degree in software engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, or a related discipline.

The ideal candidates will have many of the following competences.

  • artificial intelligence experience (including explainability and interpretability)

  • experience in development of AI-augmented decision support tools

  • experience in interdisciplinary work

  • experience in working with external stakeholders and domain experts

  • knowledge of the health domain

 

About MMMI and SDU HIT

MMMI is an internationally recognized research department that conducts research within robotics, drone technology, artificial intelligence, I4.0, software engineering as well as health and energy informatics.

SDU HIT conducts interdisciplinary research related to data driven health technology in close collaboration with experts from various fields. There is a strong emphasis on the development of high TRL systems related to intelligent monitoring and decision support; predictive models for prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis; digital health systems offering novel personalized data collection, treatment plans and interventions. SDU HIT has research activities in areas such as geriatrics, mental health, compassion, cancer, cardiology, kidney disease, osteoporosis, and multiple sclerosis.

 

Additional information

For further information about the positions, please contact Professor Uffe Kock Wiil, phone +45 6011 3565, email ukwiil@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is August 25, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms
This appointment as a research assistant is part-time and temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from October 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

jobs.title: Postdoc Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
jobs.description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more postdoc positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a two-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

  • State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

  • Real-time perception.

  • Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

  • Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

  • Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the appointment, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center’s project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect

We expect that you hold a PhD degree or expect to be awarded one before the start date, within engineering, robotics, computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

  • Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

  • Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

  • Perception and machine learning for robotics.

  • Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

  • UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

  • Motivated application.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

jobs.title: Projektipäällikkö, kansainväliset projektit
jobs.description:
Jalo & Jalo on vuonna 1972 Turussa perustettu perheyritys, joka on erikoistunut henkilönostamiseen. Viime vuosien vahvan kasvun ja yrityskauppojen ansiosta olemme tänä päivänä Pohjoismaiden suurin nostolava-autoja vuokraava yritys.

Toimimme Suomessa valtakunnallisesti kahdeksasta toimipisteestä käsin. Lisäksi meillä on Ruotsissa tytäryhtiö Svenska Höjdliftar, joka toimii Tukholmasta käsin. Yrityksemme palveluksessa on yli 100 henkilönostamisen ammattilaista ja kalustossamme on 175 erilaista henkilönostinta pienistä saksilavoista suuriin nostolava-autoihin.

**Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa ja kehittämässä kasvavaa kansainvälistä liiketoimintaa Pohjoismaissa?**

Etsimme kansainvälisiin toimintoihimme oma-aloitteista, järjestelmällistä ja tavoitteellista **projektipäällikköä** vastaamaan projektien johtamisesta, asiakassuhteiden kehittämisestä sekä liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta erityisesti Ruotsin ja Norjan markkinoilla sekä tarvittaessa Baltian alueella.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan kehittämään kansainvälistä liiketoimintaa yrityksessä, jolla on jo vahva perusta, olemassa oleva asiakaskunta ja toimivat prosessit. Et aloita työtä tyhjältä pöydältä, vaan pääset rakentamaan tulevaisuutta olemassa olevan pohjan päälle yhdessä kokeneen ja sitoutuneen tiimin kanssa.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, viranomaisten, yhteistyökumppaneiden sekä oman organisaatiomme operatiivisten toimintojen kanssa. Tehtävä edellyttää aktiivista otetta, kykyä hallita laajoja kokonaisuuksia sekä halua matkustaa Pohjoismaissa.

**Tehtävänkuva**

Projektipäällikkönä vastaat muun muassa:

- projektien myynnistä ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä

- projektien suunnittelusta, käynnistämisestä ja johtamisesta

- tarjouslaskennan ja sopimusneuvotteluiden tukemisesta

- kansainvälisten projektien lupa- ja viranomaisasioiden koordinoinnista

- resurssien suunnittelusta yhteistyössä toimipisteiden ajojärjestelyn kanssa

- projektien aikataulujen, kustannusten ja laadun seurannasta

- yhteistyöstä asiakkaiden, viranomaisten, alihankkijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa

- uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta ja kehittämisestä


**Odotamme sinulta**

- tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta ja/tai työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista

- kokemusta projektijohtamisesta tai esihenkilötehtävistä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä

- kykyä johtaa useita samanaikaisia projekteja tavoitteellisesti ja järjestelmällisesti

- vahvoja organisointi-, yhteistyö- ja neuvottelutaitoja

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- valmiutta matkustaa Pohjoismaissa ja tarvittaessa Baltian alueella

- kykyä toimia itsenäisesti, ottaa vastuuta ja tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia sekä kykyä omaksua uusia järjestelmiä ja toimintamalleja

- halua kehittää sekä omaa osaamistasi että yrityksen toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti


**Arvostamme erityisesti**

- ruotsin kielen taitoa, joka katsotaan eduksi

- kokemusta kansainvälisestä liiketoiminnasta tai projektitoiminnasta

- Pohjoismaisten markkinoiden, toimintatapojen ja viranomaisvaatimusten tuntemusta

- kokemusta teollisuuden, energiateollisuuden, infrastruktuurin tai rakennusalan projekteista

- näyttöjä asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta

- yrittäjähenkistä, ratkaisukeskeistä ja tavoitteellista työotetta


**Henkilönä olet**

- itseohjautuva ja aloitteellinen

- luotettava ja vastuuntuntoinen

- tuloshakuinen, mutta pitkäjänteinen

- rohkea tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin

- hyvä tiimipelaaja, joka osaa toimia eri sidosryhmien kanssa kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä


**Tarjoamme**

- vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän kasvavassa yrityksessä

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa kansainvälisen liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen

- mielenkiintoisia projekteja Pohjoismaissa ja Baltian alueella

- osaavan organisaation tuen ja matalan hierarkian työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä kansainvälisen liiketoiminnan avainroolissa


**Hae mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme tulevaisuuden kansainvälistä liiketoimintaa!**

Hae tehtävää täyttämällä hakemus. Liitä hakemukseesi CV:si sekä palkkatoiveesi. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral researcher position on monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare at the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our international team working on monitoring animal health and welfare.

The position is for two years and will commence December 1, 2026, or soon thereafter. The position is within the research section Management and Modelling.

The research section Management and Modelling develop methods and tools for herd management to promote animal welfare, green transition, and economic viability. Further, the section integrates, develops, and disseminates knowledge of farm animal management and relationships between actors and animals. Researchers in the section teach BSc, MSc and PhD in animal and veterinary science educations and conduct research-based public advice for national and international authorities on animal welfare and health.

The research section is a dynamic multidisciplinary research group including animal scientists, veterinarians, economists, statisticians, and anthropologists.

The position

We seek a post doc to evaluate data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in all major livestock production systems (cattle, pig and poultry). The post doc will contribute to identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in pig welfare inspection. The post doc will also contribute to the development of training materials in targeting pig welfare inspectors in EU member states.

Your profile

We are looking for a candidate who:
  • Holds a PhD or equivalent academic qualifications.
  • Has research experience in monitoring animal welfare, health or production on any of the major livestock production systems (cattle, pigs or poultry).

Research tasks
  • Evaluating data and monitoring tools for assessing animal health and welfare in cattle, pig or poultry
  • Identification of animal-based indicators for pig welfare to be used in screening of pig welfare in relation to inspection
  • Development and evaluation of training and testing programmes targeting European pig welfare inspectors

The preferred candidate will also engage in and further develop ongoing research and teaching within the Management and Modelling group.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal-experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.

Who we are

Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, and health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

ANIVET has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further
information about the department; https://anivet.au.dk/en

Contact

Further information on the position may be obtained from Head of Research Unit, Professor Jan Tind Sørensen, phone: +4520783343, email: jantind.sorensen@anivet.au.dk.

Living in Denmark

Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential family.

Place of employment and place of work

The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.


Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.


Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: PhD Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
jobs.description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more PhD positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a three-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

  • State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

  • Real-time perception.

  • Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

  • Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

  • Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the PhD studies, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center's project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect
We expect that you hold an MSc, or expect to complete one before the start date, in engineering, robotics, or computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

  • Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

  • Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

  • Perception and machine learning for robotics.

  • Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

  • UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Työpaikka on Lahdessa, mutta työ vaatii liikkumista koko P-H hyvinvointialueella. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus ja ajokortti on välttämätön.

Noudatamme Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:iä. Koeaika on kaksi kuukautta.

jobs.title: Projektledare till projektet AI Boost Västra Nyland, deltid
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och stärka företagens konkurrenskraft i framtidens digitala arbetsliv?

Projektet AI Boost Västra Nyland syftar till att stärka småföretags kompetens inom artificiell intelligens (AI) och digital transformation i Västra Nyland. Genom samarbete mellan Yrkeshögskolan Novia, företagarföreningar, kommuner, företag och studerande utvecklas företagens förmåga att använda AI i praktiken för att effektivisera verksamheten, utveckla nya arbetssätt och skapa hållbar tillväxt

Projektet genomförs i samarbete med Hangö Företagare rf, Företagarna i Raseborg och Hangö stad. Projektet omfattar bland annat behovskartläggningar, workshops, kunskaps- och resursverkstäder, nätverksbyggande, samarbete med studerande samt utveckling av en öppen digital plattform för kunskapsspridning. Målet är att stöda minst 30 företag att stärka sin AI-kompetens och ta nästa steg i sin digitala utveckling.

Dina arbetsuppgifter
Som projektledare har du det övergripande ansvaret för projektets genomförande och fungerar som länken mellan projektets partners, deltagande företag och övriga intressenter.

I rollen ingår att:

- leda, planera och följa upp projektets verksamhet
- ansvara för projektets ekonomi, rapportering och administration tillsammans med ekonomispecialist
- koordinera samarbetet mellan företag, företagarföreningar, kommuner, studerande och andra intressenter
- planera och genomföra workshops, seminarier, nätverksträffar och andra projektaktiviteter
- koordinera behovskartläggningar och kompetensutvecklingsinsatser för företag
- bidra till utvecklingen av modeller för AI-kompetensutveckling och företagssamarbete
- säkerställa projektets synlighet, kommunikation och resultatspridning
- medverka i framtagningen av rapporter, publikationer och projektets digitala kunskapsplattform

Projektledaren ansvarar särskilt för projektets helhet, inklusive ledning, uppföljning, rapportering, kommunikation och samordning av projektets aktiviteter.

Vi söker dig som har
- högre högskoleexamen inom ett relevant område
- erfarenhet av projektledning
- god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska, finska och engelska
- erfarenhet av samarbete med företag och externa intressenter
- god samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av nätverksarbete

Vi värdesätter
- kunskap om artificiell intelligens, digitalisering eller affärsutveckling
- erfarenhet av kompetensutveckling, utbildning eller workshopfacilitering
- erfarenhet av företagsutveckling eller arbete med små och medelstora företag
- god kännedom om näringslivet, företagsstrukturen och utvecklingsbehoven i Västra Nyland
- erfarenhet av offentligt finansierade projekt (EU-, landsbygds- eller regionala utvecklingsprojekt)
- intresse för regional utveckling, innovation, entreprenörskap och framtidens arbetsliv
- förmåga att arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och resultatinriktat

Vi erbjuder
- en central roll i ett aktuellt och framtidsinriktat utvecklingsprojekt
- möjlighet att bidra till småföretagens digitala transformation och AI-utveckling
- möjlighet att omsätta AI i praktiken tillsammans med företag, studerande och andra aktörer
- ett brett nätverk av företag, kommuner, företagarföreningar och utbildningsaktörer i Västra Nyland
- en stimulerande arbetsmiljö med engagerade kollegor och goda möjligheter till professionell utveckling
- möjlighet att arbeta i gränslandet mellan forskning, utveckling, utbildning och näringsliv

Anställning
för tiden 14.9.2026-31.7.2028 eller enligt överenskommelse. Anställningen är 50 % av helhetsarbetstiden.

Lön enligt kollektivavtal för yrkeshögskolor och interna direktiv. Till befattningen hör en prövotid på sex månader.

Rekryteringen är kopplad till offentligt finansierade projekt.

Placeringsort
Åbo. Arbetet genomförs som en hybridlösning med möjlighet till distansarbete och resor inom projektområdet.

Närmare information
Kontakta forskningsledare Kenneth Nordell, mobil 040 822 8467, e-post fornamn.efternamn@novia.fi

Ansökan
Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast tisdag 25.08.2026 kl. 23.59. Ansökan inlämnas via vårt elektroniska system. Till ansökan bifogas ansökningsbrev och CV.

jobs.title: Reparatør til teknisk afdeling i ABENA Produktion
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med fejlfinding, reparation og vedligehold på højteknologiske produktionsanlæg i en hverdag med faste rammer, dygtige kolleger og stor variation? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Du bliver en del af vores tekniske afdeling, hvor reparatører, elektrikere, teknikere og lærlinge arbejder tæt sammen om at holde produktionen kørende. Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger, høj faglighed og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for både opgaverne og hinanden.

Hos ABENA producerer vi hver dag over 3 millioner højkvalitets-bleer til både babyer og voksne. Produktionen foregår på avancerede maskinanlæg, der kræver teknisk forståelse, præcision og godt samarbejde på tværs af produktion og teknisk afdeling.

Om jobbet

Din hverdag bliver alsidig og teknisk udfordrende. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre stabil drift på vores produktionsanlæg, og du arbejder tæt sammen med både kollegerne i teknisk afdeling og medarbejderne i produktionen.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • fejlsøge, reparere og vedligeholde maskinanlæg

  • udføre forebyggende vedligehold

  • ombygge og tilpasse maskinanlæg

  • koordinere opgaver ved vedligeholdsstop

  • arbejde i vores IT-baserede vedligeholdssystem

  • deltage i omstillinger og klargøring

Vi er i udvikling og investerer løbende i nye maskiner og ny teknologi. Derfor får du gode muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt og bringe din viden i spil i en moderne produktion.

Jobbet er primært på daghold. Derudover skal du være indstillet på at arbejde på aftenhold i gennemsnit ca. hver 6. eller 7. uge og have tilkaldevagt ca. hver 12. weekend. Der kan også forekomme perioder, hvor der er brug for din hjælp på natskiftet. 

Vi har stærkt fokus på sikkerhed. Hos os kommer sikkerhed altid først, både i måden vi arbejder på i produktionen, og i den måde vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen. Vi forventer, at du bidrager aktivt til et sikkert arbejdsmiljø.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi leder efter dig, der er fagligt stærk og trives med at være en del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en relevant baggrund som fx smed, landbrugsmekaniker, automekaniker, automatikmekaniker eller lignende

  • har erfaring med vedligehold

  • har kendskab til MAG/TIG svejsning, drejebænk, tegningslæsning, lejemontage, systematisk fejlfinding og pneumatikstyring

  • arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar og hjælper dine kolleger

  • taler og skriver dansk

Hvorfor vælge ABENA?

Hos ABENA Produktion får du et spændende og afvekslende job i en virksomhed, hvor vi prioriterer både faglighed og mennesker. Du bliver en del af en afdeling med godt arbejdsklima, engagerede kolleger og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Vi lægger vægt på:

  • et stærkt fællesskab med samarbejde og godt humør

  • en moderne produktion med avancerede maskinanlæg

  • gode muligheder for udvikling og efteruddannelse

  • kantineordning, motionsrum og sundhedsordning

  • en arbejdsplads med tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde

Hos ABENA skal det være trygt, rart og motiverende at gå på arbejde. Vi tror på ordentlighed, godt samarbejde og høj faglighed, og vi sætter en ære i at passe godt på hinanden, vores kunder og vores leverandører.

Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og CV snarest gennem vores ansøgningssystem. Vi behandler ansøgningerne efterhånden, som vi modtager dem, indtil vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Såfremt der er spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte vedligeholdelsesleder Bo Amdi Holm på tlf.: 51580560.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Online Game Presenter  Malta
jobs.description:
Malta är känt som en av Europas soligaste destinationer och erbjuder fantastisk natur, vackra stränder och ett livligt nattliv. Här möts du av turkost vatten, historiska fästningar och vänliga människor, vilket skapar en unik och oförglömlig upplevelse. Föreställ dig att vakna till ljudet av vågorna och sedan gå ut för att upptäcka den vackra naturen eller de charmiga gatorna i Maltas städer.

Observera att du måste ha giltiga resehandlingar. Vi kommer även att kräva ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret samt en skriftlig referens från din senaste arbetsgivare.

Vi erbjuder

    Relocation-paket som inkluderar flyg, upphämtning på flygplatsen och tre veckors hotellboende
    Månatliga bonusar baserade på prestation, teamwork och lojalitet
    Utvecklingsmöjligheter, exempelvis Team Leader, Shift Leader eller Trainer/Coach
    Prestationsbonus
    Gratis gym
    Rabattkort
    Många sociala aktiviteter, såsom PlayStation, pingis, årlig båttur och temadagar för olika högtider som jul, St. Patrick’s Day och mycket mer
    Sjukförsäkring

Om företaget

Företaget du kommer att arbeta för har som mål att hjälpa operatörer att lyckas och samtidigt erbjuda slutanvändare en förstklassig användarupplevelse genom ett professionellt och lokaliserat Live Casino.

Visionen är att behålla och stärka sin position som världens ledande leverantör av Live Casino i takt med att spelmarknaderna fortsätter att utvecklas globalt.

Studion på Malta sänder på 18 olika språk och våra team består av över 40 olika nationaliteter, vilket skapar en dynamisk och internationell arbetsmiljö.

Om jobbet

Som Online Game Presenter ansvarar du för att spel som Poker, Blackjack och Roulette genomförs korrekt och professionellt. Samtidigt är det ditt ansvar att spelarna vid ditt bord får en professionell och engagerande internationell spelupplevelse.

Du kommer att tillbringa större delen av arbetsdagen framför kameran, där du presenterar spelen och interagerar med spelarna. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina presentations- och kommunikationsfärdigheter samt din förmåga att hantera flera saker samtidigt.

Som Game Presenter tar du presentation och underhållning till en helt ny nivå.

Du kommer att ha livliga, positiva och interaktiva samtal med spelarna vid bordet och bidra till att skapa en engagerande spelupplevelse genom din energi, personlighet och förmåga att underhålla.

Vi kräver ingen specifik tidigare yrkeserfarenhet, men vi ser gärna att du har arbetat deltid eller heltid i minst ett till två år, gärna inom service, kundservice eller liknande.

De första tre veckorna av din anställning kommer att tillbringas på vår Academy, där du får utbildning i hur du presenterar Blackjack- och Roulette-spel samt hur du agerar professionellt framför kameran.

Dina kvalifikationer

💭 Du talar och skriver svenska (eller finska) på modersmålsnivå och har goda kunskaper i engelska (stark B2-nivå).

🎓 1–2 års erfarenhet inom service, kundservice eller liknande är meriterande.

💻 Du är serviceinriktad och har god kommunikationsförmåga samt förmåga att hantera kunder professionellt online.

💪🏻 Du är snabblärd, flexibel och en lagspelare.

🥇 Du är professionell, mogen och ansvarsfull, har lätt för att följa arbetsrutiner och regler och har en naturlig vilja att prestera och nå dina mål.

Har du frågor?

Om du har några frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta jessica@recruitas.com via e-post.

jobs.title: Erfarne asbestmedarbejdere Experienced Asbestos Removal Technicians søges i Vejle – 250 kr./time ved asbestarbejde + egen firmabil
jobs.description:
Skadeservice.nu vækster, og vi oplever en markant stigende efterspørgsel på specialiserede saneringsopgaver. Derfor udvider vi nu vores asbestafdeling i Vejle og søger 2-3 erfarne asbestmedarbejdere, som skal indgå i et nyt team.

Har du erfaringen og papirerne i orden, og vil du være med til at præge kulturen og samarbejdet i et nystartet team? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet og din rolle

Som en del af vores nye team kommer du primært til at arbejde med større og mindre asbestsaneringsopgaver i og omkring Vejle. Arbejdet kræver høj faglighed og et kompromisløst fokus på sikkerhed og kvalitet.

Da vi er en skadeservicevirksomhed, kan der også forekomme almindelige skadeserviceopgaver, f.eks. i forbindelse med vand-, brand- og social rengøring.

Når du er oplært og klar til det, vil du desuden indgå i vores vagtrul sammen med dine kolleger. Du bliver naturligvis ikke sat på vagt, før du har den nødvendige introduktion og er tryg ved vores arbejdsgange og procedurer.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med dine faste makkere, og som en del af et helt nyt team får I stor medindflydelse på, hvordan arbejdsdagen tilrettelægges, og hvordan vi sammen opbygger en stærk afdeling i Vejle.

Din faglige profil
Vi leder efter kandidater, der kender håndværket til bunds og kan gå selvstændigt til opgaverne fra dag ét. Vi forventer, at du har stor respekt for de gældende sikkerhedsregler og procedurer på området.

Derudover er det krav, at du:

  • Har et gyldigt asbestcertifikat.

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med asbestarbejde.

  • Har kørekort B – fordel med B/E kørekort

Som person er du mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og en god holdspiller, som forstår vigtigheden af at kunne stole på sine kolleger, når man arbejder med miljøfarlige stoffer.

Vi tilbyder
Skadeservice.nu er en arbejdsplads med en flad organisation og højt til loftet. Vi passer på vores medarbejdere og sørger for, at udstyret altid er i orden.

Når du bliver en del af holdet, kan du se frem til:

  • En attraktiv lønpakke, der forhandles efter dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Vi tror på åbenhed omkring løn og vilkår. Som medarbejder hos Skadeservice.nu aflønnes du med:

174,61 kr. pr. time i grundløn

+ 75 kr. pr. time ved asbestarbejde

+ 27,40 kr. pr. time ved skadeservicearbejde

Tillæggene udbetales afhængigt af den type arbejde, du udfører, og kan ikke kombineres.

Ved asbestarbejde får du dermed 249,61 kr. pr. time.

  • Egen fuldt udstyret firmabil.

  • Firmatelefon og professionelt arbejdstøj/sikkerhedsudstyr.

  • Muligheden for at udvikle dig i en virksomhed i fremgang.

Læs mere om vores virksomhed og vores værdier på www.skadeservice.nu

Opstart hurtigst muligt
Vi har travlt og ønsker at samle det nye sjak hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder derfor samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet de rette profiler.

Send din ansøgning, dit cv og en kopi af dit asbestcertifikat til info@skadeservice.nu allerede i dag.

Vil du høre mere om stillingerne og planerne for det nye sjak, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Mathias drift og udvklingschef Mathias Brandhøj på telefon 40 22 51 93, Asbest ansvarlig Casper Andersen på telefon 22 26 76 78 eller Lars Andersen på 91 91 04 04 til en uforpligtende snak.

Experienced Asbestos Removal Technicians – Vejle, Denmark

Skadeservice.nu is expanding its asbestos division and is looking for 2–3 experienced Asbestos Removal Technicians to join a new team in Vejle. You will carry out asbestos removal projects while ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality and compliance. We offer an attractive salary based on experience, a fully equipped company vehicle, work phone, professional equipment, and excellent opportunities to help shape a growing team. A valid asbestos certificate, documented experience and a Category B driving licence are required. Immediate start.

Apply by sending your CV and a copy of your asbestos certificate to: info@skadeservice.nu

For more information, please contact:

Mathias Brandhøj +45 40 22 51 93

jobs.title: Fitnessinstruktør/medhjælper til Loop Fitness Ringkøbing
jobs.description:
Vi er et center i udvikling og søger derfor nye medarbejdere – og meget gerne en studerende, fleksjobber, efterlønner eller lign. Der er tale om en timelønnet stilling omkirng 6-12 timer ugentligt primært tirsdag og torsdag eftermiddag og flere ved weekend, ferie mm. 

Beskrivelse af jobbet og forventninger:

En stor del af jobbet vil være kontakt med vores medlemmer, instruere brugerne af vores maskiner og koncept, samt rengøring.

Efter grundig kort oplæring af vores koncept, skal du udføre prøve- og instruktørtimer til nye og nuværende medlemmer ved guidning og fysisk instruktion.

Du skal på brugerniveau kunne benytte vores eget IT-system til at oprette nye medlemmer, oprette aftaler mm. Du skal kunne tale og skrive dansk, da du både er i personlig kontakt, telefonisk kontakt og skrivende kontakt med medlemmer og kollegaer.

Du skal være smilende, serviceminded og empatisk og du skal kunne kommunikere med kunder i alle aldre

Du skal fysisk kunne deltage i rengøringsopgaver i centret, da vi sætter stor pris på at vores center altid er pænt og rent, men opgaverne er tilpasset og opdelt.

Du skal kunne træne i vores udstyr og hvis man har lyst, er der mulighed for at kunne undervise i holdtræning.

Du skal selvstændigt kunne arbejde på vagter af 2-4 timers varighed ad gangen hvor man aktivt skal være i centret i hele vagten, gående og stående med afveksling. Vagterne kan ligge i både formiddags- og eftermiddagstimerne, samt i weekender.

Der vil til tider være arrangementer, events og outgoing opgaver.

Vi forventer at du er god til at skabe kontakt til andre mennesker, er ansvarsbevidst, selvkørende, smilende og udadvendt. At du kan få alle vores medlemmer til at føle sig velkommen, hver gang de kommer og træner.

Hvad kan du forvente af os:

I LOOP er vi kendt for vores gode service og nærvær og vores arrangement sammen med vores medlemmer, så du vil blive en del af et godt team, der hjælper hinanden og du vil få en arbejdsplads med skønne sociale medlemmer omkring dig.

Hos os kan du forvente et arbejde med frihed under ansvar, du vil blive grundigt oplært i den daglige drift, og der vil løbende være kurser der oplære dig i korrekt brug af maskinerne mm.

Lyder det som jobbet for dig, så send en mail til centerleder Rikke på ral@loopfitness.dk

Der vil løbende blive indkaldt til samtaler, med opstart snarest muligt.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.



Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.





Role Summary

You know the power of great execution, how it doesn’t just follow strategy, but shapes it. As Project Manager at Scania’s Project Office, you will lead some of the most critical industrialization programs within Scania, turning strategic direction into tangible business results. Your leadership will make a real difference. You will guide complex, cross-functional programs from decision to delivery, ensuring seamless industrial introductions that meet Scania’s EBIT goals and strengthen our premium offering. Together with executive leaders and other project managers, you will help move Scania’s strategy from vision to value, always with the customer in focus.

Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

·      Lead large-scale industrialization programs supporting Scania’s strategic goals when industrializing Product Development projects from TRATON GROUP PMO.

·      Ensure successful execution of projects that are critical to Scania’s truck business profitability, securing smooth introductions without disruptions to the industrial system.

·      Guide and coach other project and program managers at Scania’s Project Office, contributing to a strong and learning project culture.

·      Navigate and lead business decisions across relevant governance and decision-making forums.

·      Collaborate with executive leadership and provide strategic insight into Scania’s project portfolio, supporting both direct management and the executive board in decision-making.

·      Drive clarity and alignment across complex interfaces, ensuring that stakeholders stay focused on common priorities and outcomes.

Who You Are



You are an experienced and trusted Project Manager with a strong track record of leading complex, high-impact projects. You bring both strategic perspective and operational precision, and you know how to drive results through others.

We believe you have:

    A Master’s degree, preferably in Engineering, Business, or an equivalent field.
    Significant project management experience, ideally gained within Scania or the wider TRATON Group. Experience from executive decision-making arenas is highly valued.
    Strong business understanding and the ability to balance strategic objectives with operational realities.
    Proven leadership experience, including leading other leaders and managing cross-functional teams.
    Full professional proficiency in English; Swedish is an advantage.

Your leadership combines structure and empathy, and you bring stability, focus and collaboration even in high-stakes situations. You are as comfortable discussing strategic directions with executives as you are guiding your team through the day-to-day complexities of execution.            

This Is Us

At the Scania Project Office, we lead programs and projects that define the future of Scania’s premium offering. We act where business and product meet, ensuring that strategy is realized through strong, value-driven execution. We believe in collaboration, coaching and continuous learning. Our mission is to make sure that product development and industrialization deliver real value, to our customers, our business and our people.

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-21. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Please be advised that a bit longer response time can be expected in this case because of the summer holiday period during July and beginning of August. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.



If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Magda Blosinska, Talent Acquisition Specialist, magda.blosinska@scania.com



We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.description:
**We Are Hiring Cleaners in Ylitornio**

Are you interested in working in an international and people-oriented environment where appreciation, trust, and commitment are reflected in everyday actions, and where you are given opportunities to develop and grow? At N-Clean, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

At the beginning of your employment, your workplace will be a retail store. Work is primarily performed on weekday evenings, although shifts can be arranged within the stores opening hours. In this role, you will independently take responsibility for the cleanliness of our customer site and perform other customer service tasks related to cleaning services. You will play an important role in ensuring the smooth running of daily operations. You are expected to work responsibly, follow safety and quality procedures, and take care of your working environment.

**Your responsibilities include, among other things**

- Daily cleaning and maintenance tasks

- Ensuring quality in your own work

- Using cleaning equipment and materials correctly and taking proper care of them

- Cooperating with customers and colleagues

- Working independently and carefully

- Demonstrating responsibility and reliability

- Having a willingness to learn and develop your skills


**What we expect from you**

- The ability to understand work instructions, communicate regarding employment matters, and ensure safe working practices in either Finnish or English. The position does not require fluent Finnish skills, and English language skills can replace Finnish language skills. We value a diverse work community where different language and cultural backgrounds are seen as a strength.

- A way of working that supports a safe, equal, and respectful workplace

- If you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit

- Previous experience in cleaning or facility services, relevant education, a driving licence, and access to your own car are considered an advantage.


**What we offer**

- A fixed-term employment contract, 10 hours per week

- A competitive salary in accordance with the collective agreement, €11.33–€12.59/hour from 1 August 2026

- Comprehensive onboarding and support when starting your employment through our renewed Onboarding Path and the N-Clean Academy

- Employment begins on a mutually agreed date and ends on 30 September 2026

- Opportunities to develop your skills and advance through internal career paths

- A safe and respectful work community

- A responsible employer that ensures fair employment conditions, a safe working environment, and employee well-being

- A people-oriented workplace and an eNPS score of 55


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect, regardless of their background. We do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and transparently while maintaining a safe and supportive work community.

**Why Join Us?**

Our top priority is that you enjoy your work and feel that what you do matters. We invest continuously in employee experience and smooth everyday work, and it shows in the results: our employee eNPS score is an outstanding 55.

This is not just a number. It is reflected in everyday life through a positive atmosphere, appreciation, and teamwork. We have also received recognition for our work:

- In 2024, we were named Finlands Most People-Oriented Workplace

- In 2025, we achieved 3rd place in the same category

- In 2025, we also achieved 3rd place in the Finlands Most People-Oriented Working Life Act category


These results are based on our employees experiences and feedback, and they guide our continuous development.

At N-Clean, you also have the opportunity to develop professionally and advance your career. Many of our supervisors and managers started their careers as cleaners and have progressed to positions with greater responsibility. We support skills development and provide opportunities for further training and new roles based on your interests and expertise. Read our career stories on our website and get inspired!

**Apply and become part of a top team!**

Submit your application no later than 25 August 2026. We review applications during the application period, and the position may be filled or closed before the application deadline.

We only accept applications submitted through the application form on our website.
