jobs.title: Køkken souschef søges til Muban Thai Roskilde
jobs.description:
KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL THAIRESTAURANT

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret køkken souschef, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift i vores thairestaurant.

Du bliver en central person i køkkenet og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og resten af teamet. Vi leder efter dig, der har passion for det thailandske køkken, tager ansvar og kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt.

Om restauranten

Vi er en thairestaurant med fokus på autentiske smage, gode råvarer og retter tilberedt med respekt for det traditionelle thailandske køkken.

I køkkenet arbejder vi blandt andet med wokretter, curries, nudler, risretter og forskellige klassiske thailandske specialiteter. For os er kvalitet, smag og konsistens afgørende, og vi lægger stor vægt på, at gæsterne får den samme gode oplevelse hver gang.

Restauranten tilbyder både servering i restauranten og takeaway, og derfor kræver hverdagen et køkken, hvor samarbejde, planlægning og effektivitet går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som køkken souschef vil du blandt andet:

  • Støtte køkkenchefen i den daglige ledelse og koordinering af køkkenet

  • Tage ansvar for køkkendriften, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

  • Koordinere arbejdsopgaver og sikre et effektivt flow under travl service

  • Sikre, at retterne lever op til restaurantens krav til smag, kvalitet og præsentation

  • Deltage aktivt i tilberedning, produktion og mise en place

  • Planlægge prep og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

  • Introducere, oplære og støtte nye medarbejdere

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en positiv arbejdskultur i køkkenet

  • Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lagerbeholdning og korrekt opbevaring af råvarer

  • Arbejde aktivt med at begrænse madspild og sikre et fornuftigt vareforbrug

  • Overholde og følge gældende regler for hygiejne, egenkontrol og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Bidrage med idéer til udvikling og forbedring af retter og menuer

  • Hjælpe med at sikre en stabil og velfungerende køkkendrift – også når der er ekstra travlt

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

  • Gerne har erfaring med thailandsk eller anden asiatisk gastronomi

  • Har interesse for eller erfaring med at lede og koordinere et køkkenteam

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt som en del af et hold

  • Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan bevare roen og prioritere opgaver i travle perioder

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og ensartethed i køkkenet

  • Gerne har kendskab til woktilberedning, curries og traditionelle thailandske smage

  • Har forståelse for køkkenhygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og arbejdsopgaver

  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Kendskab til thai er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En vigtig rolle med ansvar og mulighed for indflydelse

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde, kvalitet og god energi

  • Mulighed for at arbejde professionelt med thailandsk gastronomi

  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Varierende arbejdsdage og ansvar i den daglige køkkendrift

  • Fleksibel planlægning af vagter

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger en souschef, som ikke er bange for at tage fat, og som gerne vil være med til at udvikle både køkkenet og teamet.

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR THAI RESTAURANT

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Kitchen Sous Chef to become an important part of the daily operation of our Thai restaurant.

As Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. We are looking for someone who is passionate about Thai cuisine, takes responsibility and is able to stay organised and focused in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

About the restaurant

We are a Thai restaurant focused on authentic flavours, quality ingredients and dishes prepared with respect for traditional Thai cuisine.

Our kitchen prepares a variety of dishes, including wok dishes, curries, noodles, rice dishes and classic Thai specialities. Quality, flavour and consistency are very important to us, and we aim to provide our guests with a great experience every time they visit or order from us.

We offer both dine-in service and takeaway, which means that teamwork, planning and efficiency are essential parts of our daily kitchen operation.

Your main responsibilities

As Kitchen Sous Chef, your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the Head Chef with the daily management and coordination of the kitchen

  • Taking responsibility for kitchen operations when the Head Chef is not present

  • Coordinating tasks and maintaining an efficient workflow during busy service periods

  • Ensuring consistent standards of taste, quality and presentation

  • Taking an active part in food preparation, production and mise en place

  • Planning prep work and distributing tasks among kitchen staff

  • Training, supporting and assisting new kitchen employees

  • Contributing to strong teamwork and a positive working environment

  • Managing deliveries, stock levels and correct storage of ingredients

  • Helping reduce food waste and maintaining efficient use of ingredients

  • Ensuring compliance with food hygiene and food safety procedures

  • Contributing ideas for new dishes and menu development

  • Helping maintain an organised and efficient kitchen during both normal and busy service periods

About you

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has relevant experience from a professional kitchen

  • Preferably has experience with Thai or other Asian cuisine

  • Has experience with, or an interest in, supervising and coordinating kitchen staff

  • Can work independently while also being a strong team player

  • Is organised, reliable and responsible

  • Can remain calm and prioritise tasks during busy periods

  • Has a strong focus on quality and consistency

  • Preferably has knowledge of wok cooking, curries and traditional Thai flavour profiles

  • Understands food hygiene and food safety requirements

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and responsibilities

  • Can communicate in English. Knowledge of Thai is an advantage but is not required.

We offer

  • A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

  • An important role with responsibility and influence on daily kitchen operations

  • A professional and informal working environment focused on teamwork and quality

  • The opportunity to work with authentic Thai cuisine

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Varied responsibilities and working days

  • Flexible shift planning

  • Salary based on experience and qualifications

We are looking for a Sous Chef who enjoys taking responsibility, working as part of a team and contributing to the continued development of both the kitchen and the restaurant.

Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with employers to expand organisational recruitment networks, strengthen workforce engagement, and identify sustainable employment opportunities. jobs.title: Spanien Abonnemangssäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till kallkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Tour Operator
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and operate FIT and group tours across the Nordic and Baltic countries.

  • Design customized itineraries based on clients' interests and market needs.

  • Coordinate all travel arrangements, including accommodation, transportation, guides, restaurants, and activities.

  • Negotiate rates, contracts, and service conditions with hotels, DMCs, transport companies, and other suppliers.

  • Prepare quotations, manage tour costs, and maintain product profitability.

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with travel agencies and business partners across Southeast Asia.

  • Resolve operational issues quickly and efficiently to ensure a seamless travel experience.

  • Work closely with internal teams and overseas partners to deliver exceptional service.

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience as an Inbound Tour Operator for Southeast Asian travel market.

  • Experience handling FIT and group travel operations.

  • Strong itinerary planning and travel operation skills.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • A proactive attitude, attention to detail, and excellent problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Solid understanding of the Southeast Asian travel market.

  • Knowledge of Southeast Asian cultures, travel trends, and customer preferences.

  • Existing network within the Southeast Asian travel industry.

  • Proficiency in Southeast Asian languages (Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, etc.).

  • Experience operating tours in the Nordic and Baltic regions.

  • Experience negotiating contracts and rates with hotels, transport companies, DMCs, and other suppliers.

  • Strong cost control and quotation preparation skills.

  • Experience handling travel emergencies and operational issues.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel).

Why Join Us?

  • Work with one of the world's most exciting travel destinations.

  • Be part of an international and multicultural team.

  • Opportunity to develop and expand the Southeast Asian market.

  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.

  • Competitive salary and benefits based on experience and qualifications.

If you are passionate about creating unforgettable travel experiences and have the expertise to grow our Southeast Asian business, we look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on Notion’s Services team, you will lead the hands on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. You will design, build, and deploy production ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business.



You’ll embed with enterprise customers to design and build solutions that integrate Notion deeply into their technical and operational environments. This includes writing and maintaining custom code, designing and deploying production-grade custom agents and AI workflows with MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, building data pipelines and resolving complex challenges around scale, permissions, and governance.



You’ll embed with enterprise customers to design and build solutions that integrate Notion deeply into their technical and operational environments.



This is a customer-facing engineering role for someone who is comfortable writing code, debugging technical issues, explaining tradeoffs to stakeholders, and turning ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. Your work will help shape best practices for how we support complex customer needs and ensure Notion’s platform is ready for scale.



This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers make informed architectural decisions and identify opportunities to expand and deepen their use of Notion.

 - Work directly with customer engineering, IT, security and business stakeholders to gather technical requirements, identify constraints, evaluate feasibility, and make sound architectural decisions that maximizes the value of Notion within their broader technical ecosystem.

 - Troubleshoot complex implementation issues across APIs, integrations, automation logic, data quality, permissions, authentication, system limits, and customer specific environments.

 - Design and operate feedback loops with Product, CX, and Engineering, translating real-world implementation challenges into actionable insights, technical requirements, and tooling improvements that directly influence Notion’s Product Roadmap and our Customers.

 - Build reusable technical assets, including migration tooling, integration patterns, reference implementations, discovery frameworks, technical standards, scripts, and internal delivery tooling.

 - Help define how Services delivers complex technical implementations at scale by improving methodologies, scoping artifacts, build patterns, technical documentation and engineering best practices.

jobs.title: Manager salle de Loisirs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez l'aventure d'un nouveau centre La Tête Dans Les Nuages à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91)
Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Dans le cadre de l'ouverture prochaine de notre nouveau site à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91), nous recherchons notre futur(e) Manager Loisirs.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management de proximité et le contact client ? Vous souhaitez participer à une ouverture de site et contribuer à sa réussite dès les premiers jours ? Alors rejoignez-nous !

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Site, vous êtes un acteur clé de l'exploitation quotidienne du centre.
Véritable relais managérial sur le terrain, vous accompagnez les équipes et veillez à offrir à chaque visiteur une expérience mémorable.

- Manager et accompagner les équipes
- Participer au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
- Former, accompagner et animer les équipes au quotidien.
- Garantir la bonne application des procédures et des standards de qualité.
- Fédérer les équipes autour de la satisfaction client et de l'esprit de service.
- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.
- Contrôler la bonne tenue des espaces de loisirs et d'accueil.
- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.
- Garantir la disponibilité et la qualité des prestations proposées.
- Être un véritable ambassadeur de La Tête Dans Les Nuages
- Partager votre enthousiasme avec les équipes et les visiteurs.
- Contribuer à créer une ambiance conviviale et dynamique.
- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en management de proximité, idéalement dans l'un des secteurs suivants :
Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

Conditions du poste

Travail selon planning variable.
Présence requise les week-ends, jours fériés et certaines soirées selon l'activité du site.
Deux jours de repos consécutifs en semaine.
Horaires aménagés dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.
Les avantages
Tickets restaurant après 2 mois d'ancienneté.
Mutuelle d'entreprise.
Prise en charge des transports en commun à hauteur de 50 %.
Intégration au sein d'un groupe leader du loisir indoor.
Participation à l'ouverture d'un nouveau site ambitieux.

jobs.title: Har du erfaring med autisme, angst og PTSD – og motiveres du af at skabe udvikling gennem en stabil, tillidsfuld og fagligt funderet relation?
jobs.description:
Vi søger medarbejdere til en længerevarende § 85-indsats omkring en ung mand i Aarhus. 
Målet er at etablere et lille, fast team, som kan skabe kontinuitet, genkendelighed og tryghed omkring borgeren.

Om indsatsen

Borgeren har autisme, angst og svær PTSD og har behov for struktureret og forudsigelig støtte i hverdagen.

Han kan opleve svære angstanfald, som i perioder påvirker hans evne til at handle og gennemføre almindelige hverdagsaktiviteter. En central del af opgaven er derfor at kunne bevare roen, skabe tryghed og støtte ham i at udvikle og anvende mestringsstrategier, når angsten fylder.

Samtidig er han selv motiveret for udvikling og progression. Der er derfor gode muligheder for at arbejde målrettet med små, men betydningsfulde skridt mod større mestring og selvstændighed.

Hvad skal du arbejde med?

Den socialpædagogiske støtte har blandt andet fokus på:

  • mestringsstrategier i forbindelse med angst og angstanfald
  • støtte til at finde ro og genvinde handlekraft i belastende situationer
  • struktur og opretholdelse af en stabil døgnrytme
  • støtte til hensigtsmæssige rutiner omkring søvn
  • social færdighedstræning
  • gradvis træning i at færdes uden for hjemmet, eksempelvis gennem gåture
  • støtte til aktiviteter uden for hjemmet og øget selvstændighed i hverdagen.

Opgaven kræver, at du kan arbejde roligt, tålmodigt og relationsorienteret. Du skal kunne møde borgeren dér, hvor han er, uden at forcere processen – samtidig med at du har blik for hans ressourcer, motivation og muligheder for progression.

 

Du bliver en del af et fast team

Kontinuitet er en vigtig del af indsatsen. Derfor søger vi medarbejdere, som ønsker at blive en del af et lille og fast team omkring borgeren.

Teamet skal så vidt muligt være selvdækkende og sammen skabe den stabilitet og genkendelighed, som borgeren har behov for.

I teamet deler I faglige perspektiver, metoder, observationer og erfaringer, så der skabes en fælles og sammenhængende tilgang til indsatsen. Der afholdes desuden løbende teammøder med mulighed for faglig sparring og koordinering.

 

Arbejdstider

Indsatsen leveres på faste tidspunkter:

Mandag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Tirsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Onsdag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Torsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Fredag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Søndag: kl. 21.00-23.00

 

Fra 1. september øges dagvagterne til fire timer og placeres kl. 8.00-12.00 eller kl. 9.00-13.00.

Vagttidspunkterne ligger fast og kan ikke flyttes.

Du behøver ikke kunne dække alle vagterne. Vi hører også gerne fra dig, hvis du kan varetage én eller flere faste vagter og dermed indgå stabilt i teamet.

 

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, som har de faglige og personlige kompetencer til at arbejde med en borger med autisme, angst og svær PTSD.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af områderne og eksempelvis har en social-, pædagogisk- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • kan skabe ro, tryghed og forudsigelighed
  • kan bevare ro og overblik, når angsten fylder
  • arbejder respektfuldt og relationsorienteret
  • forstår betydningen af struktur og kontinuitet
  • kan arbejde udviklingsorienteret med respekt for borgerens tempo
  • er stabil og kan forpligte dig på faste vagter
  • bidrager aktivt til faglig sparring og et tæt teamsamarbejde.

Af hensyn til borgerens konkrete behov kan indsatsen udelukkende varetages af kvindelige medarbejdere.

Der er aktuelt ingen fastsat slutdato på indsatsen, og vi søger derfor medarbejdere, som har mulighed for at skabe kontinuitet over tid.

 

Kan du se dig selv i opgaven?

Hvis du har erfaring med autisme, angst og/eller PTSD og trives i et tæt relationsarbejde, hvor udvikling sker gennem tryghed, struktur og vedholdenhed, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ved interesse får du naturligvis yderligere information om borgeren, støttebehovet og de faglige rammer som en del af den videre rekrutteringsproces.

 

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Teammøder, supervision og konflikthåndteringskurser
  • Faglig udvikling og sparring med kolleger
  • Attraktiv løn iflg. overenskomst

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV samt dine uddannelsesbeviser ved at klikke "Søg Stillingen" længere nede på siden.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor Position in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering. SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The position is available from January 1, 2027, with the specific start date to be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

 

The position and research environment 

You will join the maritime group at Mechanical Engineering, where the main research topics are seakeeping, data-driven maintenance, and energy systems and efficiency. The group works within applied research, carried out in close collaboration with industry and other research groups. The group is part of the larger Maritime Center at SDU, offering strong opportunities for transdisciplinary and cross-faculty collaboration. In addition, the center is actively developing strong relationships with external partners. The candidate is expected to play an active role in this community, contributing both to research and administrative activities within the center. This includes outreach to other universities, industry, maritime educational institutes, authorities, and professional organizations to establish and strengthen collaborative relationships.

Furthermore, SDU conducts defense-related research. The successful candidate is therefore expected to have an interest in dual-use research within the relevant research fields, and to actively engage in outreach to other universities as well as the Danish Defence.

To complement our team, we are looking for candidates within naval architecture and marine engineering / mechanical engineering, with documented research experience in one of the following fields:

  • Data-driven operation of ships – Energy efficiency and predictive maintenance, digital twins, and the use of machine learning and sensor data to optimize vessel operation and efficiency.

  • Seakeeping and comfort onboard vessels - ship motion analysis, ship stability, vibration and noise reduction, or human comfort and habitability at sea.

You will bring competence and dedication to teaching and student supervision in mechanical engineering at SDU ME, actively contributing to our two educational programs: Bachelor of Engineering (diplomingeniør) and Bachelor's and Master of Science (civilingeniør). Our engineering programs combine theory courses with project work, and you will be involved in both. 

 

Workplace

SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The research activities at SDU ME span widely from fluid mechanics, multi-physics simulation and optimization to condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and naval architecture and marine engineering. IME is a multidisciplinary department covering also high-frequency electronics, microelectronics, batteries and super-capacitors, additive manufacturing, smart structures and energy technologies. The department is an exciting environment, where you will be exposed to many different fields and have your general academic curiosity stimulated.

The position is full-time and located at the SDU main campus in Odense. Given the research, teaching, and collaborative nature of the position, you are expected to be present on campus on a regular basis and to relocate to Denmark, if currently residing abroad.

SDU Odense is the university’s largest campus and provides a strong framework for interdisciplinary research, teaching, and innovation. You will be part of a modern workplace with high professionalism, strong academic communities, and a commitment to diversity and equal opportunities. SDU also offers dedicated support for International Staff. Learn more about careers and work life at SDU here: Careers at SDU.

 

What we expect 

You must have:

  • Completed a PhD degree in a relevant discipline

  • The ability to teach basic mechanical engineering curricula

  • Communication skills in English at an adequate level for research communication and teaching

It is preferred that you also have experience from/with:

  • Postdoctoral research positions

  • Co-supervision of PhD students

  • Teaching and course development

  • Funding applications

  • Collaboration with industrial partners

You are expected to apply for own grants and to contribute to joint applications with the group and its collaborators. Strong potential to compete for national and international research funding is essential.

During the period of employment as Assistant Professor, you are expected to develop an independent research profile; publish high-quality research outputs; contribute to attracting external research funding; develop documented teaching and supervision competences, including completion of the Lecturer Training Programme; and contribute actively to collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the academic environment at SDU Mechanical Engineering.

 

Further information 

For more information about the position, contact Head of Section Associate Professor Dorte Smedegaard Schmidt (phone +45 65507432, e-mail dss@sdu.dk) or Professor Marie Lützen (phone +45 65509625, e-mail mlut@sdu.dk).

For more information about SDU ME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/da/mechanical.

For more information about IME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime. 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application (up to 2 pages). 

  • Complete Curriculum Vitae (up to 4 pages).

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications. 

  • Up to 10 publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • A proposed research plan (up to 4 pages).

  • References/reference letters may be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: Restaurant ONE TEN forstærker køkkenet
jobs.description:
Efter snart 3 år siden åbningen er Restaurant ONE TEN Providence nu klar til vol.2. Søger i den forbindelse en dygtig a la carte kok, der kan håndtere det varme parti.

ONE TEN er et lille familieejet fine dining restaurant inspireret af det franske og nordiske køkken. Blot 10 retter på kortet (plus plateau de fromage), hvor enkelte af retterne skifter efter sæson. dynamisk samarbejde med tjenerstaben, der flamberer og rører tartar tableside blandt gæsterne. Med så få retter er der ekstrem fokus på smag og sammensætninger. Her bruges ikke molekylær gastronomi, men søger i stedet at præsentere det smukke i råvarernes mere naturlige egenskaber.

ONE TEN var allerede Københavns bedst anmeldte restaurant på Google og TripAdvisor blot 1 år efter åbningen. I 2025 blev Restaurant ONE TEN yderligere tildelt "best of the best" af TripAdvisor og således blandt verdens bedste procent af restauranter. Succesen er primært vægtet på køkkenet - og forstærket af et kompetent tjenerstab. Et meget stærkt team for teamets skyld - ikke for en stjernekok.

Køkkenchef Sandra Larsen dyrker en meget inkluderende kultur, hvor alle hjælper alle og ingen er vigtigere end andre. ONE TEN kalder det for "omvendt hierarki", hvor dem med mest erfaring hjælper dem med mindre erfaring. Tonen er effektiv under service, familiær under prep og nysgerrig under menuudvikling. Personlighed og kemi er således vigtigere end kandidaternes lange cv'er - men uden de rette kompetencer, faglige stolthed og passion for at levere det bedste produkt i teamets navn hver evig eneste gang er stillingerne ikke interessante.

Vi søger en kandidat med god erfaring, kompetent erfaring og passion for at videreudvikle egne personlige kompetencer. ONE TEN er ikke et sted blot for jobbets skyld - det er et sted for kandidater, der måske har en drøm om selv ville drive restaurant en dag og være med på den spændende rejse ONE TEN Providence er på. Måske vil kandidaterne blot føle at være en del af et ekstremt succesfuldt team, der mod alle odds har klaret sig gennem alle udfordringer.

Stillingen er fuldtids a la carte kok. Lønnen aftales efter kompetencer og driftens behov. Dette er ikke en lederstilling, men i stedet en stilling, der på sigt kan give en god frihed til personlig udvikling og indblik i en speciel gren af branchen.

Vi får typisk rigtig mange ansøgninger og kun en lille procentdel kaldes til samtaler. Vi anbefaler derfor kun meget seriøse kandidater søge.

Glæder os meget til at møde jer...

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Consultants, Japan
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise Segment, Japan to lead Notion's Enterprise GTM motion in Japan as we evolve how we sell, build, and deliver outcomes for our largest customers. This is a senior second-line leadership role, leading leaders and teams across the Enterprise segment, with accountability for new logo acquisition, expansion, renewals, and the quality of execution that produces durable customer outcomes.

This person will play an integral role in scaling Notion's evolving GTM motion in Japan. You'll help define what great looks like for the Enterprise segment: how teams identify the right accounts, create urgency with executives, diagnose workflows, run compelling first and second meetings, deliver live builds and value narratives, and hand customers off into adoption with clarity. This is not a traditional pipeline-management role. The best leaders in this motion are coaches first: they can inspect the quality of a customer conversation, watch a live build or deal review, and tell a manager or IC exactly what to change.

As part of the Japan GTM leadership team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our Enterprise sales motion, meaningfully shape our product and customer strategy, and drive revenue growth while building a high-performing team. We need someone with an entrepreneurial and builder spirit, strong enterprise operating discipline, and experience leading through managers. This person should enjoy coaching leaders and reps to be the best they can be, be data-driven, and be experienced in managing complex, high-velocity Enterprise pipeline across new business, expansion, and renewal motions.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead the Japan Enterprise Segment strategy, including territory design, account prioritization, pipeline generation, executive engagement, expansion strategy, renewal health, and long-term revenue growth

 - Lead and develop first-line leaders and senior ICs across the Enterprise motion, raising the bar on coaching quality, operating cadence, performance management, and team execution

 - Own the commercial performance of the Enterprise segment across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, renewals, and UBP outcomes, accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Scale the evolved GTM motion in-market, including account strategy, workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture, live builds in Notion, value narratives, mutual action plans, and adoption hand-offs

 - Build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence for the segment, including weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, forecast calls, and leadership reporting

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects (Sales and Customer Success), BDR, Partnerships, Marketing, Deal Desk, Ops, Legal, and Product to build playbooks and define how Notion wins with Enterprise customers in Japan

 - Partner with BDR leadership on Enterprise pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, qualification standards, and messaging so the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Solutions Consultant and Outcomes Architect leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy, owning the overall commercial arc while collaborating on execution after close

 - Represent Japan Enterprise customer and team signal in regional and global leadership forums, clearly identifying what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Attract, hire, onboard, certify, and retain a world-class Enterprise organization, building a culture of high performance, coaching, accountability, and collaboration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 10+ years of B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or workflow technology experience, with a proven track record of winning and growing Enterprise customers

 - 3+ years of second-line leadership experience, with experience leading managers or multiple teams through a defined operating cadence, performance management, and talent development rhythm

 - Strong understanding of PLG and SLG sales motions, with successful experience combining bottom-up adoption with top-down executive selling in Enterprise accounts

 - Proven ability to scale a GTM transformation or new sales motion, including enablement, inspection, manager coaching, playbook adoption, and consistent execution across teams

 - Strong enterprise customer instincts, with the ability to guide teams through complex discovery, multi-stakeholder evaluation, technical validation, business case creation, and adoption planning

 - Deep coaching orientation: you can inspect a deal review, customer call, or live build and identify specifically what needs to change, not just whether the outcome was good

 - Strong analytical judgment, able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, use customer and team signal to build strategy, and drive urgency without micromanaging

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Deal Desk

 - A builder mentality who thrives in collaborative environments, operates well in ambiguity, and creates structure, playbooks, and operating rhythms where they do not yet exist

 - Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior customer stakeholders and represent Japan Enterprise priorities to regional and global leadership

 - Fluency in Japanese (native or bilingual level) and English (high-business level)

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and deliver stronger customer outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading Enterprise GTM in Japan or across APAC for a high-growth SaaS or AI company

 - Experience leading through a major GTM organizational change, sales methodology rollout, segment redesign, or role redesign across Enterprise teams

 - Experience selling or leading teams in a consumption, usage-based, or adoption-led business where customer outcomes matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage, including hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Strong technical fluency or experience working closely with technical sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, or partner teams

 - Experience selling through or partnering with systems integrators, channel partners, or strategic alliances in Japan

 - Experience with quarterly or annual sales planning, territory planning, and Enterprise capacity planning




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

jobs.title: Analyste développeur Odoo (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Vous vous intéressez à la transformation digitale et vous êtes passionné par l'analyse ? Rejoignez l'Administration des contributions directes qui est en pleine transformation digitale et offrez-vous l'opportunité unique de jouer un rôle stratégique dans la transformation digitale d'une des plus grandes administrations du pays, essentielle au fonctionnement de l'Etat. Le poste d'analyste développeur Odoo sera affecté à la division informatique de l'ACD qui travaille activement à la digitalisation des démarches et du parcours client, en se focalisant sur une refonte des systèmes existants, une optimisation des processus tout en assurant un environnement de travail optimal pour les agents. Vous contribuerez directement à moderniser le service public et à améliorer l'expérience des citoyens. L'Administration des contributions directes, forte de plus de  agents, répartis sur  équipes, dans  immeubles et  communes, a pour mission de collecter les impôts et taxes nécessaires au financement des services publics et au bon fonctionnement de l'Etat. Ce rôle vous place au carrefour de l'innovation technologique et de l'impact sociétal, en participant activement à l'avenir numérique et stratégique de l'Etat. Missions En tant qu'analyste développeur, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de développement en charge de la mise en place de solutions logicielles basées sur des technologies modernes. Vous contribuerez activement à la digitalisation et à l'optimisation des processus métiers de l'ACD à travers le développement d'applications répondant à des besoins fonctionnels complexes. Le poste concerne plus particulier/ièrement les missions suivant/antes : Participation au processus d'élaboration des exigences fonctionnelles et non-fonctionnelles ; Définition de l'architecture et des spécifications techniques ; Réalisation et déploiement de nouvelles applications informatiques ; Maintenance et évolution des applications existant/antes ; Participation aux tests d'intégration et à la gestion des releases ; Application des bonnes pratiques de développement (clean code, qualité logicielle, sécurité) ; Collaboration étroite avec les équipes internes et les parties prenant/antes métiers ; Interaction avec le métier afin de comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées ; Contribution à l'amélioration continue et veille technologique. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience professionnelle minimale de plus de 5 ans en développement ; Excellente maîtrise de Python (langage et frameworks associés) ; Bonne maîtrise des technologies web (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, etc.) ; Expérience dans le développement d'ERP (Odoo ou équivalent) ; Connaissances solides en bases de données relationnelles et maîtrise du SQL ; Connaissance des standards et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (de la conception à la production) ; Expérience avec des outils de gestion de version (Git ou équivalent) ; Maitrise obligatoire des langues françaises et anglaises. Compétences comportementales Passion pour le développement logiciel et les technologies Open Source ; Intérêt pour le clean code et les architectures logicielles modernes ; Curiosité pour les technologies émergentes ; Capacité à analyser et vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes ; Facilité de collaboration en équipe et bonnes capacités de communication ; Capacité à travailler en autonomie et de manier/ière proactive ; Rigueur, sens de la méthode et respect des échéances. Atouts Contributions à des projets Open Source ; Expérience avec des outils tels que PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes ; Connaissances ou expérience avec des architectures modernes (microservices, etc.) ; Expérience en administration de systèmes Linux ; Expérience dans des environnements de développement collaboratifs et agiles ; La maîtrise des langues luxembourgeoise et allemande constituant un avantage. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un bachelor en informatique ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A2.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Merchandising Execution Associate 7117 Strathcona
jobs.description:
Are you someone who thrives on helping others succeed, enjoys making an impact, and takes pride in guiding customers to the right solutions for their projects? If youâre also naturally curious and eager to keep learning, consider starting or growing your career with us at The Home Depot.

Position Overview

Merchandising Execution Associates (MEAs) perform in-store merchandising service activities such as merchandising projects, planogram maintenance, overhead organization, and display/signage maintenance designed to enhance the customer experience. MEAs execute merchandising strategies and ensure product is displayed correctly to drive sales and maximize inventory turns. MEAs work in teams with on-site supervision, and provide service to multiple departments in the stores. These associates execute approved general bay service, tasking, projects and resets safely, accurately and efficiently. MEAs must build and maintain strong relationships with store associates and provide superior customer service to both internal and external customers.

Key Responsibilities

Merchandising: General Service, Tasking, Packdown, and Projects

  • Read and interpret directions to ensure merchandise is set to the planogram, project instructions, program service requirements and general service guidelines
  • Straighten, clean and merchandise product to ensure merchandise is presented in a visually appealing manner
  • Maintain copy of most recent planogram inside upright beam adjacent to product set
  • Build displays and fixtures using basic hand tools
  • Maintain, order, and install display material/signage/brochures
  • Follow directions and processes to conduct accurate price and label changes. Replace incorrect, damaged, or missing price labels.
  • Maintain aisle
  • Utilize store systems to access key merchandising reports. Read, interpret, and execute action based on findings.
  • Maintain bay service records and other documentation as directed.
  • Execute one off projects as required by store, district, and regional leadership.

Customer Service

  • Maintain aisle cleanliness so that merchandise is accessible and customers are able to move throughout the aisles easily
  • Partner with store leadership to markdown all damaged or un-sellable merchandise
  • Answer questions regarding the store and products for the customers.
  • Partner with store associates to find necessary products to fit the customer's needs.

Other

  • Partner with store representative to conduct inspections of returned and damaged items for Return to Vendor.
  • Follow standard operating and safety procedures.
  • Complete assigned training curriculum
  • Other duties as assigned

Competencies

  • Action Oriented
  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality

Skills

  • Basic computer skills with knowledge of web based applications.
  • Interpersonal skills, working on teams, with heavy reliance on team to accomplish goals.
  • Follows safety policies and procedures. Identifies and corrects safety hazards.
  • Attention to Detail: Stays attentive and aware, catches errors before completing assignments, and maintains high quality standard for work.
  • Drives Execution & Self Motivated: Demonstrates the ability to deliver results without close supervision despite a large workload, competing demands, and fast paced environment. Ensures tasks are completed on time, without error, and meet quality standards.

Direct Manager/Direct Reports

  • Reports to Merchandising Execution Supervisor (MEAS)

Notre client, groupe en forte croissance sur le marché du coliving, nous mandate pour le recrutement d'un(e) Directeur Adjoint de Résidence (F/H) sur Toulouse.


Au sein d'une résidence de nouvelle génération alliant logements, espaces partagés et services, vous intervenez sur des sujets commerciaux, opérationnels et administratifs liés au fonctionnement général du site. Positionné(e) comme le bras droit de la Direction, vos principales missions sont les suivantes Participer à la commercialisation de la résidence : visites, relances, rédaction et signature des contrats, suivi des arrivées et des départs Contribuer à la mise en place de la politique commerciale et marketing du site (animation des réseaux sociaux, partenariats locaux avec les entreprises, écoles et acteurs du territoire Assurer le suivi quotidien des réservations de court séjour et long séjour en accompagnant l'équipe de réception Coordonner l'activité quotidienne des équipes et des prestataires externes (maintenance, entretien, intervenants événementiels Participer à l'animation de la vie du site : organisation d'évènements, développement de la communauté de résidents, suivi de la satisfaction Définir avec la direction les KPI's spécifiques au co-living et aider au clôtures mensuelles Veiller au respect des procédures et des critères de qualité, d'hygiène et de sécurité Assurer le remplacement du Directeur en cas d'absence Description du profil :

Issu(e) d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'au moins deux ans d'expérience dans le domaine de l'hôtellerie, de l'hébergement ou de l'exploitation de résidences.

La résidence accueillant une clientèle internationale, la maîtrise de l'anglais est exigée pour le poste.


Vous rejoignez un groupe dont le réseau de résidences s'étoffe chaque année, et où les parcours d'évolution interne (vers des fonctions de direction de site ou des périmètres élargis) sont une réalité.

jobs.title: Store Manager - dubbu
jobs.description:
About the job

dubbu is expanding in Copenhagen, and we are looking for a Store Manager (37 hours/week) to lead our upcoming store — a new version of a familiar location, now including a small serving area inspired by Korean café culture.

As Store Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, the team, and ensuring that both the retail space and the serving area run smoothly every day.

You will work closely with the founder team and have significant influence on how the store develops in the coming years.

Your responsibilities

Leadership & team

  • Daily leadership of the team (scheduling, onboarding, training, and feedback)

  • Ensuring a high standard of customer service and sales

  • Coaching the team to improve performance on the sales floor

Store operations

  • Overseeing daily operations (opening/closing, stock deliveries, inventory, routines)

  • Ensuring the store always appears well-organized and ready for customers

  • Working with simple KPIs (sales, conversion rate, AOV)

Serving area

  • Responsible for the operation of the store’s small café area

  • Ensuring consistent quality and service speed

  • Daily cleaning, hygiene, and maintenance of equipment

  • Training staff in workflow and standards

  • Contributing to the development of new drinks inspired by Korean café culture

We are looking for someone who

  • Has 2–3 years of experience in retail or café environments, preferably with operational responsibility

  • Is structured and comfortable working with routines, checklists, and clear standards

  • Can lead a team and maintain calm and overview in a busy environment

  • Is hands-on and takes ownership of both people and operations

  • Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of a well-executed customer experience

It is a plus if you

  • Have experience with barista work, matcha, or espresso

  • Have worked with food hygiene or basic food safety procedures

  • Have experience with merchandising or retail visuals

  • Have an interest in Korean culture, cafés, or beauty

What we offer

  • A central role in a growing company

  • Close collaboration with the founder team

  • Significant influence on the store’s development

  • A strong team and an ambitious brand universe

  • Staff discount across our entire product range

Join our Digital Factory at Deloitte Luxembourg — a multidisciplinary team of ~85 technology professionals and financial domain experts working together to build high-impact digital solutions for the financial sector. We develop modern, data-driven products serving clients in banking, investment funds, and asset management, in a collaborative Agile environment with a strong focus on engineering quality and continuous improvement.

As a Senior Engineer, you will be a key technical pillar of the team – owning solutions end-to-end, shaping our engineering practices, and helping grow the people around you.



Your advantages of joining us:


Work that has real impact

Build and architect data-intensive applications used by major financial institutions, leveraging modern engineering standards and AI-enabled tooling. Your decisions will directly influence product quality and client outcomes.


Technical leadership & career growth

Take ownership of architectural decisions and technical direction, with a clear path toward Lead Engineer and Architect roles. Benefit from a dedicated learning budget, internal tech talks, and access to Deloitte's global knowledge network.


Global reach, local roots

Contribute to international projects and collaborate with diverse teams across Deloitte's global network, all while being anchored in Luxembourg – one of Europe's leading financial centers.


Flexible, inclusive culture

We trust our people. Enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, a culture where your voice genuinely shapes how we work, and a team that values both performance and wellbeing.


A team that builds together

Work side by side with financial experts, product owners, and fellow engineers in a startup-minded environment within a globally recognized firm.



How you'll contribute to our success:


Engineering & Architecture:

•    Architect, develop, and own robust full-stack applications from concept to production, with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, and maintainability in a financial services context
•    Design and implement high-performance, data-intensive APIs, processing workflows, and integrations using C#/.NET and SQL Server
•    Define and apply sound architectural patterns (e.g., clean architecture, CQRS, event-driven design) appropriate to the problem at hand
•    Build scalable, performant user interfaces with React, applying strong component architecture and state management best practices


Quality & Engineering Standards:

•    Define, promote, and enforce engineering standards across the team: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E), and CI/CD pipeline ownership
•    Own non-functional requirements including performance, security, and observability
•    Proactively identify technical debt and drive pragmatic remediation plans


Leadership & Collaboration:

•    Act as a technical mentor for junior and mid-level engineers, supporting their growth through pairing, feedback, and knowledge sharing
•    Lead technical discussions and drive consensus across engineers and business stakeholders

  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work
