jobs.title: Business Analyst Data (F/H) h/f
jobs.description:
Description de l'entreprise
Le Groupe BPCE, avec son modèle de banque coopérative universelle, représenté par 9 millions de sociétaires, est le deuxième acteur bancaire en France. Avec 105 000 collaborateurs, il est au service de 30 millions de clients dans le monde, particuliers, professionnels, entreprises, investisseurs et collectivités locales. Il est présent dans la banque de proximité et l'assurance en France avec ses deux grands réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d'Epargne ainsi que la Banque Palatine. Chez BPCE Equipment Solutions, nous sommes spécialisés en financement des ventes et des équipements professionnels aux entreprises et nous sommes leader en Europe et n°2 mondial sur notre marché. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis à l'international nous sommes régulièrement primés notamment aux Leasing Life Awards en tant que "SME Champion of the year" et / ou « European Lessor of the year ». Entité à taille humaine, agile et innovante, rejoignez-nous pour partager notre Vision : "We want to be a leading provider of innovative and flexible solutions to finance and manage equipment. We are a digital and customer-centric organization, committed to deliver an excellent experience to vendors partners and clients across countries. We are a great place to work, driven by simplicity, agility and sustainability."
Poste et missions
Vous rejoignez l'équipe de Vincent, composée de 22 personnes en tant que Business Analyst Senior.Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data en place au sein de BPCE ES, répartie entre Paris et Bangalore. Cette équipe a en charge la gestion de la plateforme Data utilisée pour le pilotage commercial, financier, risque et Conformité de BPCE ES. Elle est aussi porteuse des principes Data à appliquer dans les projets de la Business Unit, sur la Data Quality ou la Protection des données.Dans cette équipe, vous aurez notamment l'occasion de contribuer au programme d'intégration de BPCE ES dans le Groupe BPCE, ainsi qu'au support des sujets transverses de la filière Data.Au quotidien, vous avez pour missions de :Recueillir les besoins auprès des Métiers, spécifications et validation des développements de la plateforme Data & Reporting réalisés dans l'équipe Accompagner les entités de la BU sur les évolutions de la plateforme Data et de la filière DataSupporter l'équipe dans les activités de Data Management, notamment le pilotage des usages DataContribuer aux pratiques agiles de l'équipe (slicing, priorisation par la valeur.) et accompagner le métier dans la transformation agileVous aurez l'occasion de partager de votre expérience au sein d'un environnement multiculturel (collaborateurs à Bangalore) et très en lien avec les Métiers et leurs problématiques. Un processus de recrutement efficace : une fois votre CV présélectionné, préparez-vous à un entretien RH avec un Responsable Recrutement, suivi de deux entretiens métiers maximum. Un groupe engagé dans les enjeux sociétaux et environnementauxEn intégrant le Groupe BPCE, vous évoluez dans un environnement de travail hybride et favorisant le collaboratif.En tant qu'employeur responsable et engagé à construire un environnement de travail inclusif, nous offrons les mêmes opportunités aux talents de tous horizons, indépendamment de votre âge, origine, orientation sexuelle, handicap.Vous intégrerez un environnement international, au sein d'une communauté d'experts qui place l'excellence, l'impact et l'action collective au cœur de tout ce qu'elle entreprend.
Profil et compétences requises
Vous possédez une expérience d'au-moins 5 ans dans ce rôle, dans le domaine bancaire et autour des process métier lié au pilotage d'activité commerciale, risque et finance, idéalement dans le leasing.
Les compétences attendues sont :
- Maîtrise des environnements de type Datawarehouse et du requêtage SQL
- Maîtrise des pratiques agiles
- Capacité à coordonner des intervenants dans un contexte international
- Capacité à réaliser les tâches opérationnelles pour l'avancement du projet
- Anglais opérationnel

Une expérience de développement off-shore serait un plus.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



TEAM

Brand & Creative defines how Replit shows up in the world and leads the creative work that brings it to market. On the Brand side, the function sets company-level direction: defining the brand, shaping the narrative, and establishing how Replit is understood and expressed in the market. On the Creative side, the function leads the planning, development, and execution of creative work across campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives; translating strategy into high-quality outputs across every touchpoint. Brand & Creative ensures that what Replit is and what Replit makes remain aligned. Resulting in a clear, consistent, and differentiated brand experience across the company.




ROLE

The Brand Designer is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining the Replit brand system. The role focuses on core brand foundations and their application across key surfaces, including product and marketing. In partnership with internal and external partners, this role ensures the brand is clear, consistent, and scalable across all touchpoints. This role reports to the Brand & Creative Lead.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and evolve the Replit visual brand system

 - Design and maintain core brand assets, guidelines, and documentation

 - Apply the brand system across key surfaces including product, web, and primary marketing channels

 - Partner with Product and Design to ensure consistent brand expression within the product experience

 - Provide guidance and feedback to internal teams and external partners on brand usage

 - Partner with external design studios and agencies to develop and extend the brand system

 - Review and direct external work to ensure alignment with brand standards

 - Ensure consistency and quality across all brand-critical touchpoints

 - Develop scalable design frameworks that support long-term brand growth

 - Contribute hands-on design work on high-visibility and foundational projects




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5-7+ years of experience in brand design, visual systems, or identity design

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating brand systems, identity work, and application across multiple touchpoints

 - Expertise in typography, layout, and visual systems

 - Experience building and maintaining design systems at scale

 - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

 - Ability to balance conceptual thinking with executional rigor

 - Experience working with external agencies or design partners

 - Strong attention to detail and consistency

 - Experience collaborating with Product and cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
jobs.description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Arabic.




NICE TO HAVES:

 -  Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

jobs.title: BŪVSTRĀDNIEKS
jobs.description:
SIA "MA Vide", reģ.nr. 40103459286 ir uzņēmums, kas attīstās un paplašina savu darbību būvniecības nozarē. Mēs veidojam profesionālu darba vidi, kuras pamatā ir kvalitatīva darbu izpilde, atbildīga attieksme un ilgtermiņa sadarbība.

Darba vietas: Jaunpaukas, Lēdurgas pagasts, Siguldas novads, LV-4012;  Saurieši, Medņu iela 7, LV-2118; Zvaigžņu iela 20-27, Rīga.
Atkarībā no uzņēmuma būvobjektiem darbs var tikt veikts arī citās adresēs Rīgā un citviet Latvijā.


Darba pienākumu apraksts:

  • veikt būvobjektos nepieciešamos palīgdarbus;
  • veikt vienkāršus zemes darbus, pārvietot būvmateriālus un palīgmateriālus būvobjektā;
  • gatavot būvjavas un betona sastāvus;
  • palīdzēt uzstādīt un demontēt būvkonstrukcijas, veikt vienkāršus betonēšanas, armatūras siešanas, veidņu montāžas un mūrēšanas darbus;
  • sagatavot virsmas turpmākai apstrādei, novākt būvgružus un uzturēt kārtībā būvobjektu;
  • strādāt ar rokas un elektroinstrumentiem;
  • veikt vienkāršus nojaukšanas, remonta, apdares, krāsošanas, grīdu, koka konstrukciju izbūves un citus ēku būvniecības un remontdarbus;
  • veikt citus ar būvdarbiem saistītus darbus atbilstoši darba vadītāja norādījumiem;
  • ievērot darba aizsardzības, ugunsdrošības un darba drošības prasības.

Prasības kandidātiem:

  • spēja veikt fizisku darbu;
  • prasme strādāt ar rokas instrumentiem un būvmateriāliem;
  • spēja strādāt komandā un ievērot darba vadītāja norādījumus;
  • atbildīga attieksme pret darbu, precizitāte un darba disciplīna;
  • vēlama B kategorijas transportlīdzekļa vadītāja apliecība.

  • stabilu darb

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.



This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.



This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in English and German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €260,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Nordics
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets

 - Fluency in Swedish or Norwegian
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 OTE per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Animal Care Manager
jobs.description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420

This position presents an opportunity to create substantial impact on both organisational success and your professional advancement.  - Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to draw conclusions, optimise team performance, and drive continuous improvement.

 - Proven Track Record: Extensive experience in SaaS sales including outbound prospecting, closing new business and demonstrating an ability to consistently achieve goals in a highly competitive environment.

 - Adaptable and Resilient: Thrives in fast-paced environments, managing change with grace and a solution-focused mindset.

 - Passionate about sales, technology and AI we seek leaders who love what they do and inspire their teams.

jobs.title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:
  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.
  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
  • Develop new recipes and food products.
  • Work with food safety and quality control.
  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:
  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:
  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
  • Can communicate in English.
  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):
Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR
1st year per month 13.708 1.835
2nd year per month 17.343 2.321
Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743
Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593
  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.
  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education
Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.
The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.
Ready to take the next step?
Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?
Send your motivated application to:
Born & Kolstrup
info@mmm-rc.dk
Learn more about us:
https://mmm-rc.dk/
Instagram:
@bornogkolstrup
Learn more about ZBC:
https://www.zbc.dk
We look forward to hearing from you! Application deadline 16/8-26

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

No smoking.

jobs.title: Notino Experience Program Manager - EMEA & APAC, Early Career
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This early-career Notino Experience Program Manager role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and turns it into momentum. You’ll wear many hats across the People team, but your core job is to jump in, chart the path, and drive high-impact projects based on business priorities—bringing clarity, aligning cross-functional partners, and executing quickly so the team can deliver meaningful employee experiences across EMEA and APAC.

You’ll succeed here if you’re deeply curious, eager to grow, and excited to hone your craft in People. This is a launchpad opportunity to learn from strong leaders, build expertise across the full spectrum of People work, and help shape moments that matter—bringing energy, optimism, and genuine care for people while helping build a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers.

As the regional anchor for how Notion’s global people & environment programs come to life outside the U.S., you’ll sit at the intersection of global vision and local execution. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Notino Experience & Environment Lead for APAC & EMEA, you’ll partner closely with the Global Experience Programs team in AMER and environment teams across Dublin, Sydney, Tokyo, Seoul, and Hyderabad—translating global programs into locally relevant, high-quality experiences and building the operational infrastructure to deliver them consistently at scale.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own regional program operations. Take end-to-end ownership of key people programs across EMEA and APAC — from onboarding and performance cycles to engagement surveys and talent retention initiatives. You'll research, plan, launch, and iterate.

 - Bridge global and local. Act as the connective layer between the Global Experience Programs team and on-the-ground environment teams. You'll translate global frameworks into locally relevant experiences.

 - Build the infrastructure. Create processes, playbooks, and agents that make local execution easier and more consistent across markets. Think onboarding workflows, program calendars, and repeatable delivery frameworks.

 - Elevate Affinity Groups. Partner with Affinity Group leads across the region to strengthen their programmes, provide operational support, and help surface retention and engagement insights from within those communities.

 - Use data to drive decisions. Build and maintain dashboards that track program health, adoption, and outcomes. Use what you learn to run experiments, course-correct quickly, and demonstrate ROI.

 - Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with People Partners, NoE , Recruitment and business leaders to align people programs with organisational goals and ensure an inclusive, well-supported employee experience.

 - Champion the Notion Experience. Help craft and bring to life a more distinct Notino Experience brand across EMEA and APAC — reimagining how we work, how we connect, and what it feels like to be a Notino in your region.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Programatic: experience running people programs end-to-end, across multiple markets & time zones.

 - AI-native mindset: you’re “AI‑pilled” in the best way: you proactively use AI tools to speed up research, ops, and communication, and you’re excited to build AI agents/playbooks.

 - Project management: strong skills and the ability to hold many moving pieces.

 - Stakeholder trust: you build trust naturally across levels, from team members to executive partners.

 - Bias toward action: you’re resourceful, scrappy when needed, and energised by a fast-moving environment.

 - Change management: experience driving change at a high-growth company — you know how to bring people along, not just roll things out.

 - Executive presence: you’re comfortable presenting to and partnering with senior leaders.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with or enthusiasm for Notion

 - Experience working across APAC and EMEA markets, with an understanding of cultural nuance in employee experience.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €60,000 - €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Vos missions au quotidien

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

jobs.title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
jobs.description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Minimum of 3 years post-graduation experience in Neurophysiology and in performing nerve conduction studies & EEG’s autonomously. High Proficiency in English (speaking & writing). jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Job i Malaga - Er du vild med biler? Vi mangler en Teknisk Supporter til XPENG i Malaga.

Rollen handler om at skabe tryghed, løse problemer og guide kunder gennem både tekniske og praktiske spørgsmål. Henvendelser kommer via telefon, e-mail og chat, og du arbejder i CRM-systemer, registrerer sager og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og personlig oplevelse.

⚡ XPENG-projekter kræver erfaring eller stærk viden om elbiler. Perfekt for dig, der interesserer dig for fremtidens mobilitet og grøn teknologi.

Skaber værdi og teknisk support

Kundehenvendelser håndteres med fokus på både service og teknisk forståelse. Første niveau support gives på produkter, konti og platforme. Sager registreres korrekt og følges til løsning inden for SLA. Behov analyseres, og den rette løsning findes i samarbejde med kunden. Kunderejsen understøttes fra første kontakt til afsluttet sag.

Kommunikationen holdes professionel, rolig og hjælpsom — også når udfordringer opstår. Hver interaktion bidrager til en positiv oplevelse og styrker relationen til brandet. Ansvar tages for henvendelserne, og de følges helt til dørs eller eskaleres, når det er nødvendigt.

Et energisk og inkluderende team i Málaga står klar til at tage imod dig. Oplæringen er fuldt betalt, og der er adgang til specialiserede kurser og coaching. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og projekter inden for tech, kundeservice og elbil-industrien.

  • Samarbejde med interne teams og specialister

  • Bidrag til kundetilfredshed og loyalitet

  • Overholdelse af processer, procedurer og kvalitetsstandarder
