jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:



1) Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

2) Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

3) People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

4) People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1) Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

2) Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

 - Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.

3) Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.

4) Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Embedded, not independent: You will work as an extension of strategic People Partner leaders and existing Talent Management team, not as a separate talent silo.

 - Strategic + practical: You can shape philosophy at 10,000 feet and turn it into an executable V1 strategy in a week – not for the purpose of moving fast, but for getting opinions and engagement of the right solution fast.

 - High taste, low ego: You have strong opinions about what great talent work looks like, but you build through partnership and field feedback.

 - Systems-minded: You design for repeatability and leverage, while knowing when to do the unscalable thing first.

 - Business-first: You anchor talent work in company outcomes, not HR activity.

 - AI-native and Notion-powered: You are energized by reimagining how talent work should change when AI can remove manual coordination and amplify judgment. You also understand how Notion can support our initiatives.

 - Path-agnostic: You’re glad to start as an individual contributor and build the case for a team through impact, not title.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Peamiselt tegeleme korterite põhjaliku koristamisega pärast pikaajalist elamist. Enamasti on tegemist 1- või 2-toaliste korteritega. jobs.title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas.
Seoses suvise hooaja ja suurenenud töömahuga otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks või hooajaliseks tööks suveperioodil. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid
* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt.
Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

jobs.title: Liiklusmärkide paigaldaja
jobs.description:
Pärnu

Tööülesanded: Meie eesmärk on tagada oma klientidele ja partneritele kõige turvalisemad ja eeskujulikumad töömaad Eestis. Selleks otstarbeks kasutame parimaid ja kvaliteetsemaid liikluskorraldus- ja ohutusvahendeid: ajutised liiklusmärgid, teepiirded, ehitusaiad, käigu- ja sõidusillad, teekünnised ja pinnasekaitsematid - need on vaid mõned tootegrupid millega igapäevaselt tegeleme.
Aga parimatest toodetest üksi ei piisa, vaja on ka professionaalseid paigaldajaid, kes tooteid eeskujulikult ning professionaalselt klientide töömaale kohale viiks ning paigaldaks. Töö iseloom ei ole kindlasti lihtsaimate killast - on pikki tööpäevi ja suuri raskuseid mida tõsta. Sinu ülesandeks on erinevatel objektidel liikluskorraldustööde teostamine. Sealhulgas: - ajutise liikluskorralduse üles seadmine vastavalt seaduses sätestatud punktidele; - liiklusmärkide ja muude liikluskorraldusvahendite transport ning paigaldamine; - objektide kontrollimine ja korrashoid (märkide ümbertõstmine, asendamine jms.); - lisaks muud liikluskorralduse ning töömaaohutusega seotud ülesanded.

Omalt poolt pakume: - konkurentsivõimeline palk;
- toetav ja tore meeskond; - head töötingimused ja -vahendid; - meeleolukad ühisüritused; - koolitus ja väljaõpe on kohapeal; - sporditoetused ja nii mõnigi muu hüve veel.

Muud nõuded: kiire õppimisvõime; kohusetundlikkus ja täpsus; hea füüsiline vorm; töötahe ning võime iseseisvalt tegutseda; eesti keele oskus; B-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu; valmisolek töötada ka õhtuti ja nädalavahetustel. Eelised: eelnev töökogemus liikluskorralduse või teedeehituse valdkonnas; BE-, C- või CE-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu.

jobs.description:
Hea võimalus alustada karjääri pärast ülikooli või kutsekooli lõpetamist. Piisab inglise keele oskusest suhtlustaseme.

Tööülesanded: Jääkpaksuse mõõtmine laevadel;
Mõõtmisaruannete ja remondijooniste koostamine.

Omalt poolt pakume: Väljaõpet kohapeal;
Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu; Spordi- ja tervisetoetust (sh sportimine, massaaž ja hambaravi); Ööpäevaringset ülemaailmset õnnetusjuhtumikindlustust, mis kehtib ka väljaspool tööaega; Ainulaadset võimalust reisida ja maailma näha.

Muud nõuded: Mere- või tehniline haridus;
AutoCADi kasutamise oskus tuleb kasuks; Hea inglise keele oskus (vähemalt B1 tase) ning vene keele oskus; Valmidus sagedasteks töölähetusteks.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Vastuvõtuadministraator
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Kui Sinu jaoks on väljakutseks töötamine teenindussfääris ning soovid ennast rikastada kogemustega turismisektoris, siis pakume Sulle selleks suurepärase võimaluse. Hotelli vastuvõtu administraatorina kulgeb Sinu tööpäev mitmekesiselt ning tööülesanded hõlmavad endas:

Teenindusvalmidust erinevate klientidega suhtlemisel; Väga head eesti ja inglise keele oskust, suhtlustasandil soome ja vene keele oskust; Paindlikkust ja head pingetaluvust, ootamas on töö graafiku alusel, mis sisaldab ka öiseid vahetusi; Meeskonnatöö valmidust, ausust, täpsust ja kohusetunnet.

jobs.title: Account Executive (India)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet

 - Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for client meetings and events
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
   
   


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - ZoomInfo

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You’re not based in India area

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle; have little to no coding knowledge

 - You’re not passionate about AI

 - You don’t enjoy being in client facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to others





Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.description:

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.

We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.

We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

 - Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

 - Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

 - Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

 - Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

 - Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

 - Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

 - Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

 - Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

 - Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

 - Fluency in an additional European language

 - 3+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
jobs.description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. jobs.title: RADNIK / RADNICA NA ODRŽAVANJU
jobs.description:

jobs.description:
Opis poslova: 
 
- Održava i obavlja sve električarske radove na instalacijama, strojevima, uređajima i alatima na električni pogon u objektima marine. 
- Servisira i popravlja različite stabilne i vanbrodske motore, obavlja remont, ugradnju i precentriranje motora. 
- Kontrolira propelere, kormila i osovinske ležajeve, mijenja cinkprotektore, vadi osovine, propelere i kormila, mijenja cinkprotektore, po potrebi čisti kaljuže na brodovima. 
- Obavlja servis i popravke ostale brodske opreme, kao što pumpe, spremnici goriva i vode, cjevovodi slatke vode, mora i goriva i sl. 
- Također obavlja servis i popravke osnovne palubne opreme, kao što su vitla, vinčevi, buceli, gambeti i sl. 
- Gore spomenuti poslovi uključuju demontažu dijelova na brodu, čišćenje, zamjenu dijelova i obradu (brušenje, bušenje, rezanje i dr.) u radionici, te podešavanje i kontrolu po montaži na brodu.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect, Dublin, CEE
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 3+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - You are a fluent Russian speaker

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €89,000 - €100,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550.  https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Head of Demand Engine
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.



The playbook for B2B demand generation is changing. Buyers expect better content and experiences, AI is reshaping how programs get built, and old attribution models are under pressure. If you want to apply what already works, challenge what doesn’t, and help define a more modern model, this is the job.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $245,000 – $275,000 per year.

Are you a talented Senior Designer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

Akvariefisk, ulveskov og hverdagspædagogik er nogle af de ting, som findes i Børnehuset Derudá, hvor vi leder efter en pædagog til vores vuggestue nærmere bestemt Den Grønne Gren.

Her vil blandt andet David og Lene være dine nærmeste kollegaer. De er blandt meget andet 100 meter mestre i organisering, og har godt styr på overblikket. De er også meget åbne for dine idéer, hvis du har noget, som du brænder for pædagogisk.

Vi er et stort hus med med mulighed for åbne døre, men også med plads til ro og fordybelse bag en lukket dør til små grupper og større fællesskaber. Vi er både fælles og hver for sig.

Vi har en meget stor legeplads, hvor vuggestuen og børnehaven færdes frit. Her er svævebane, bålplads og et utal af krat, træer og gemmesteder til børnene.

Husets hjerte er køkkenfællesrummet, der binder vuggestuen og børnehaven sammen. Hver afdeling har også eget fællesrum, som vi i vuggestuen bruger til leg, musik og bevægelse.

Vuggestuen består af tre stuer (Orange Scene, Blåhvalen og Den Grønne Gren) med 11 børn på hver stue. Der går en hæk ned gennem vores legeplads, og ud fra hver vuggestue er der en lille gårdhave, hvor man bedre kan lave en afgrænset pædagogisk aktivitet. 

Vi tilbyder 

  • En arbejdsplads der vægter høj faglighed og sætter kerneopgaven i fokus. 
  • Tid til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.
  • En medarbejdergruppe som er optaget af at evaluere på egen praksis og skabe endnu bedre lege- og læringsmiljøer.
  • En vuggestue, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på strukturen og aktiviteter og være med til at udvikle praksis. 
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af huset. 
  • En masse dejlige børn og familier.
  • Koncentration i arbejdet med dagtilbud for alle og fokus på refleksion og evalueringskultur.
  • En fastansat sprogkonsulent i dagtilbuddet, som vi sparrer meget med.
  • Mulighed for at skifte stue eller afdeling, hvis opgaven kalder på det, eller man har ønske om det.
  • Opbakning til kurser og efteruddannelser.

Vi synes, det er fedt hvis du:

  • Formår at skabe gode læringsmiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene og altid har fokus på kerneopgaven og barnets perspektiv – både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet.
  • Interesserer dig for børnenes intentioner og møder dem anerkendende og åbent samt er nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag deres handlinger.
  • Aktivt medvirker til udvikling, planlægning, gennemføring, evaluering og dokumentering af pædagogiske forløb.
  • Kan bringe dig selv i spil, gå forrest og give følgeskab, i dagligdagen og i samarbejdet med kollegaer og forældre.
  • Kan lide at lege og forstår vigtigheden af voksen indlevelse og deltagelse i børns leg.
  • Kan kommunikere professionelt med forældre, kollegaer og ledelse og ønsker at sparre, så vi sikrer god kvalitet.  
  • Er smilende og imødekommende, og at du er bevidst om, at du er en vigtig rollemodel i mange forskellige sammenhænge.

Ansøgning

Vi er ikke så vilde med traditionelle ansøgninger, og måske er du heller ikke. Derfor ønsker vi, at du sender et dokument, hvor du svarer på disse 5 spørgsmål. Svarene vil give os et bedre indblik i dig som pædagog og din faglighed.

  1. Fortæl om et barn, du havde svært ved at skabe relation til. Hvad gjorde du? Og hvad lærte du?
  2. Hvad er god pædagogik i en vuggestue efter din mening?
  3. Hvordan balancerer du omsorg og tydelige rammer?
  4. Hvilken rolle mener du, den voksen skal have i børns leg?
  5. Fortæl om noget, du har ændret mening om i dit pædagogiske arbejde gennem tiden og hvorfor. 

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 men også gerne før.

Ansøgningsfrist:  14. august 2026
 
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kan du se dig selv i noget af ovenstående, eller har du nogle spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Hornemann på 23 37 20 27 eller på hornemann@aarhus.dk. Du kan også kontakte David – der er pædagog på Den Grønne Gren på 21266592.

Se mere om os på vores hjemmeside Børnehuset Derudá

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

 - Strong discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

jobs.title: Join Iceland´s Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician
jobs.description:
Join Iceland's Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Are you an ambitious and enthusiastic Consultant Physician looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact? Would you like to build a career with purpose in one of the world's most beautiful, and progressive countries?

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. We are seeking Consultant Physicians in Internal Medicine and/or Acute Internal Medicine to join our multidisciplinary team as we design, develop and deliver the next generation of emergency services in Iceland working in a leading university hospital committed to innovation, education, and research.

Experience an outstanding work-life balance in Reykjavík, where a vibrant capital city meets spectacular nature. Physicians' standard daytime working hours are based on a 36-hour working week. Enjoy safe communities, short commutes, world-class outdoor adventures, excellent schools and healthcare, and easy access to Europe and North America.

Landspitali is developing a new integrated model of urgent and emergency care focused on:
•    Improving patient flow
•    Delivering safer, more efficient and person-centered care
•    Developing innovative pathways for acutely ill patients

Successful applicants will play a key role in developing several new clinical services, including:
•    Acute Medical Unit (AMU)
•    Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC)
•    Hospital at Home

Why join Landspitali we offer:
•    A rewarding consultant-level position
•    Opportunities to take on leadership roles in developing new services
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams
•    An academic environment where clinical excellence, research, teaching and innovation go hand in hand
•    The opportunity to contribute to a transformation that will benefit thousands of patients every year
•    Excellent opportunities to achieve a healthy work life balance.
•    A supportive working environment that values staff wellbeing and professional development.
•    Structured Icelandic language training, including formal courses and digital learning resources.

The position is full-time (100%) or as otherwise agreed and is available immediately or by mutual agreement.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Clinical work across inpatient wards, the Acute Medical Assessment Unit (AMAU), and Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) services
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine inpatient admitting team
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine on-call rota
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students and resident doctors in training
•    Opportunities to participate in research activities
•    Participation in quality improvement and patient safety initiative
•    Contributing to the ongoing development of Acute Medicine and General Internal Medicine services

QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Specialist registration (or equivalent) in General Internal Medicine, Acute Internal Medicine, or Family Medicine/General Practice with an emphasis on Acute Care
•    Broad clinical experience in Acute and/or General Internal Medicine
•    Excellent communication and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
•    A commitment to quality improvement, innovation and the development of high-value healthcare services.

ABOUT THE POSITION AND APPLICATION:
Salary according to the current collective agreement concluded by the Minister of Finance and the Economy and the Medical Association of Iceland. It also depends on factors such as additional education, professional experience, and years of service. Physicians who are fully dedicated to the position in Landspítali may also receive an additional 15% salary premium in accordance with the collective agreement.

Applicants will be interviewed and decision to hire will be based on the information and documents provided by the applicants. Landspitali equal opportunities policy is taken into account when hiring at the hospital. All applications will be responded to.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS:
Please submit:
•    A cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and your vision for contributing to the development of emergency services at Landspítali.
•    A completed application form
•    A current Curriculum Vitae, including previous employment, education and professional qualifications
•    A list of any peer-reviewed publications. Applicants should either provide a Google Scholar profile link or documentation of publications indexed in PubMed.[BG1]
•    Details of teaching experience, research activities, quality improvement work and leadership experience
•    Certified copies of medical degree(s), specialist qualifications and medical licence(s)

Supporting documents must be in PDF format.

Interviews will be conducted with applicants and the decision on employment will be based on them and the submitted documents. Landspitali equal opportunities policy is considered when hiring at the hospital. All applications will be responded to.

For further information, please contact:
Bethan Elizabeth Griffith, Head Physician, The department of Emergency Assessment Unit
Email: bethane@landspitali.is,
Hlynur Indriðason, Head Physician, The department of General Internal Medicine
Email: hlynuri@landspitali.is
Telma Huld Ragnarsdottir, Head Physician, The department of General Internal Medicine
Email: telmhuld@landspitali.is,

Regarding residence and work permit, please look at our webite.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures and put "260721-02" in the field for employer.
The application deadline is up to and including August 14th, 2026

Landspitali is a vibrant and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 people work in interdisciplinary teams and collaboration between different professions. Landspitali’ s vision is to be a leading university hospital where the patient is always at the forefront. Key emphases in the hospital's policy are safety culture, efficient and high-quality services, human resource development and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Radiographer - Exciting opportunity at the Breast Centre at Landspitali - University Hospital of Iceland
jobs.description:
We are seeking an ambitious Radiographer to join our team in the screening and diagnostic imaging department at the Breast Centre at Landspitali.

We offer a comprehensive onboarding program under the guidance of experienced colleagues in a supportive and positive working environment. Our team enjoys an excellent workplace culture, with numerous opportunities for professional growth and to contribute to continuous improvements in the care and services we provide to our patients. The position is daytime only, Monday through Friday.

The screening and diagnostic imaging department at the Breast Centre at Landspitali provides breast screening, diagnostic breast imaging and radiation protection services.
The standard full-time workweek is 36 hours, with the aim of promoting employee health and wellbeing while supporting a better work¿life balance.

Employment percentage are negotiable.

Key Responsibilities
•    Carry out all mammography techniques both in screening and diagnostic imaging (X-ray images of the breasts and clinical examinations) whilst ensuring that the clients receive a caring and sensitive service.
•    Travel part time of the year throughout Iceland to perform screening mammography examinations.
•    Undertake specialized duties as required within the department.
•    Actively participate in quality improvement initiatives.
•    Maintain accurate documentation in the department's information systems.
•    Contribute to the delivery of high-quality diagnostic imaging services.
•    Work collaboratively as part of the multidisciplinary team to provide the highest standard of patient care

Qualifications
•    A valid license to practice as a Radiographer in Iceland
•    Previous experience in breast imaging is highly valued
•    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a professional attitude
•    Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
•    Commitment to fostering a positive and collaborative work environment
•    Reliable, punctual, and positive
•    Strong professional standards with the ability to work independently
•    Initiative, organizational skills, and a proactive approach
•    Good command of English, both spoken and written

Additional Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Society of Radiographers.

Application Requirements
Please submit:
•    A completed application form
•    A current Curriculum Vitae, including education, professional qualifications and previous employment
•    Certified copies of academic certificates
•    A valid license to practice as a radiographer in Iceland (or eligibility to obtain one prior to commencing employment).

Supporting documents must be submitted in PDF format.

Interviews may be conducted with shortlisted applicants, and the decision on employment will be based on the interview(s) and the submitted documents. Recruitment at Landspítali is conducted in accordance with the hospital's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be notified of the outcome of their application.

Kristrun Þorkelsdottir, Head of the Breast Centre Outpatient Clinic, Email: kristrth@landspitali.is, TEL +354 8245421

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.
